label: none

sentence: Furthermore, guiding inhaled steroid therapy by sputum eosinophil counts leads to a reduction in exacerbations in COPD, without an increase in steroid dose.
label: none

sentence: These observations demonstrate the value of identifying inflammatory subphenotypes in the treatment of COPD.
label: none

sentence: However, the application of sputum analysis is somewhat limited by the requirement of lab facilities and the not-directly available results.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, there is a need for adequate surrogate markers of airway inflammation in COPD.
label: none

sentence: Airway hyperresponsiveness (AHR) may serve as a surrogate measure of airway inflammation, since it is associated with the presence of inflammatory cells and release of mediators in the airways.
label: none

sentence: In particular, this holds for indirect challenges, amongst which dry powder mannitol challenge is relatively easy to apply.
label: none

sentence: Local mannitol deposition results in an osmotic change, likely to induce the release of mediators from inflammatory cells in the airways.
label: none

sentence: Studies in asthma showed that AHR to mannitol is indeed related to the degree of eosinophilic airway inflammation and is sensitive to treatment with inhaled corticosteroids.
label: none

sentence: Interestingly, a proof of concept study demonstrated that mannitol challenge might also be useful in identifying COPD patients who will most likely benefit from inhaled corticosteroids.

sentence: This may suggest that AHR to mannitol identifies the degree of eosinophilic inflammation in COPD.

sentence: We postulated that AHR to mannitol captures eosinophilic airway inflammation in adults with mild to moderate COPD.

sentence: Our aim was to test this hypothesis by examining the relationship between AHR to mannitol and markers of inflammation in hypertonic saline-induced sputum, blood and exhaled air.

sentence: As secondary aim, we investigated whether similar relations can be observed when using spontaneously produced sputum during or directly after the mannitol challenge itself.

sentence: Finally, we constructed receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves using AHR against sputum eosinophilia in COPD.

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: In this group of mild to moderate COPD patients, AHR to inhaled mannitol was consistently associated with eosinophil counts in hypertonic saline- as well as mannitol-induced sputum.
label: none

sentence: In addition, we observed associations between AHR to mannitol and soluble markers of inflammation in sputum.
label: none

sentence: Our results suggest that mannitol challenge identifies inflammatory subphenotypes in COPD, in particular those patients without eosinophilic inflammation due to the high specificity of the test.
label: none

sentence: This may facilitate individualized treatment in COPD.
label: none

sentence: To our knowledge, this is the first study assessing the relationship between airway hyperresponsiveness to inhaled mannitol and markers of airway inflammation in sputum and exhaled air in patients with COPD.
label: none

sentence: These observations extend previous findings in COPD using adenosine 5'-monophosphate (AMP), in which a correlation between AHR to AMP and eosinophils in sputum was observed.
label: none

sentence: Interestingly, a similar correlation between RDR to mannitol and sputum eosinophils was recently reported in patients with asthma, also showing absence of eosinophilia in patients without mannitol hyperresponsiveness.
label: none

sentence: Hence, mannitol challenge appears to provide valuable information on the inflammatory profile in both patients with COPD and asthma.
label: none

sentence: In our study, particular attention was paid to methodological aspects such as selection of COPD patients, design and methods.
label: none

sentence: The patients were derived from a clinical population rather than an epidemiological one, in order to strengthen the applicability of our findings.
label: none

sentence: All patients were well characterised by using subjective and objective criteria.
label: none

sentence: This included the presence of symptoms, fixed airway obstruction and smoking history.
label: none

sentence: The full range in sputum eosinophils counts was 0.1 to 7.4%, which is similar to previous studies in COPD.
label: none

sentence: To exclude any confounding effects of inhaled corticosteroids on mannitol challenge, the patients who used inhaled corticosteroids stopped this medication for 4 weeks.
label: none

sentence: In order to answer the research question accurately, we performed mannitol challenge and sputum induction on separate days.
label: none

sentence: In addition, we examined sputum expectorated after the mannitol itself, which confirmed our results.
label: none

sentence: Furthermore, as inflammatory markers we used both, the presence of inflammatory cells and markers of cell activation.
label: none

sentence: This provided consistent associations.
label: none

sentence: Nevertheless, our study has limitations.
label: none

sentence: First, we could not obtain adequate sputum samples in all patients at all time points.
label: limitation

sentence: Even though the power of the study was adequate to address the primary objectives, it may not have been adequate to examine our secondary objective.
label: limitation

sentence: Second, we can not exclude that our COPD group included patients who also had asthma.
label: limitation

sentence: We excluded those with a previous history of asthma, but this may not have sufficed.
label: limitation

sentence: However, all patients had a smoking history, fixed airflow limitation, met the COPD GOLD criteria, and were diagnosed and treated as COPD patients.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, the test performance cannot be generalized to COPD patients on inhaled steroids.
label: limitation

sentence: This will require a separate study.
label: none

sentence: Finally, we did not include a second mannitol challenge for examining reproducibility of our results, which is a limitation of our design.
label: limitation

sentence: How can we interpret these results?
label: none

sentence: Mannitol is an osmotic stimulus that causes airway narrowing by release of bronchoconstrictor mediators such as leukotrienes, prostaglandins and histamine.
label: none

sentence: The source of these mediators is likely to be mast cells and eosinophils in the airways as both these cell types release mediators in vitro in response to mannitol.
label: none

sentence: Mast cells and eosinophils are not unimportant in COPD and may contribute to the fluctuations of airways obstruction as observed e.g.
label: none

sentence: during exacerbations.
label: none

sentence: We did not observe associations of mannitol responsiveness with neutrophil counts in sputum or blood, but did found significant correlations with sputum IL-8 and MPO.
label: none

sentence: This may suggest that epithelial cell and neutrophil activity are also involved in determining the airway narrowing to inhaled mannitol in COPD.
label: none

sentence: Interestingly, mannitol responsiveness was more strongly associated with FeNO than with sputum eosinophils.
label: none

sentence: However, we did not find a significant association between the latter two parameters.
label: none

sentence: This is in keeping with the data by Siva et al.. Our results suggest that mannitol responsiveness is a better marker of eosinophilic inflammation than FeNO in COPD.
label: none

sentence: Notably, we observed that most COPD patients produced adequate sputum samples during the mannitol challenge.
label: none

sentence: This occurred even in absence of encouraging the patients to expectorate.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, the success rate of obtaining mannitol-induced sputum may well be improved by adjusting the standard operating procedure of the test.
label: none

sentence: Our findings extend a recent study in asthma, showing adequate sputum samples after mannitol challenge.
label: none

sentence: Inhaled mannitol changes osmolarity and reduces viscoelasticity, surface tension, contact angle and the solids content of sputum.
label: none

sentence: This may explain why 75% of the patients gave up sputum during mannitol challenge.
label: none

sentence: Our results suggest that mannitol activated eosinophils, neutrophils and epithelial cells.
label: none

sentence: Hence, even though AHR to mannitol was associated with eosinophilic airway inflammation, it is likely to be a more pleiotropic stimulus within the airways.
label: none

sentence: What are the clinical implications of our study?
label: none

sentence: Eosinophilic airway inflammation predicts the response of COPD patients to systemic and inhaled corticosteroids.
label: none

sentence: In addition, inhaled steroid therapy guided by sputum eosinophils reduces exacerbation rate in patients with COPD.
label: none

sentence: Our results suggest that mannitol challenge can identify COPD patients without eosinophilic airway inflammation, who not likely to benefit from inhaled steroid therapy.
label: none

sentence: This subphenotype of patients cannot be distinguished from other patients with COPD on clinical grounds or lung function criteria.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, mannitol challenge may qualify as a feasible alternative in the monitoring of anti-inflammatory therapy in COPD.
label: none

sentence: The high specificity (100%) in combination with limited sensitivity indicates that mannitol responsiveness is particularly suitable to exclude sputum eosinophilia in COPD.
label: none

sentence: Indeed, inhaled steroids appear to be ineffective in COPD patients with the lowest responsiveness to mannitol.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, mannitol responsiveness may support decisions to refrain from inhaled steroid treatment, thereby potentially preventing overtreatment of COPD.
label: none

sentence: This requires a randomized controlled study in COPD comparing a treatment strategy based on AHR to mannitol with the currently recommended treatment strategy based on clinical markers only.
label: none

sentence: It remains to be established whether mannitol challenge can also be an outcome measure of the efficacy of steroids in COPD, as has been shown in asthma.
label: none

sentence: Finally, our data suggest that the assessment of AHR and airway inflammation in COPD can be combined in a single test.
label: none

sentence: This would have large practical advantages, not only in clinical research, but also regarding the guidance and monitoring of anti-inflammatory therapy in clinical practice.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: We conclude that airway responsiveness to mannitol can be used to rule out eosinophilic airway inflammation in patients with mild to moderate COPD who are not treated with inhaled corticosteroids.
label: none

sentence: These finding suggests that mannitol challenge is a candidate for the guidance and monitoring of individualized, anti-inflammatory therapy in COPD, as an alternative to sputum eosinophils.
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: There has been a resurgence of interest in the relationship between physical activity and human cognitive function in recent years [1-5].
label: none

sentence: Animal evidence suggests that increased physical activity can enhance brain function [6].
label: none

sentence: Research, largely in older adults, supports the notion that aerobic exercise can enhance human brain structure, prevent age-related brain tissue loss, and improve cognitive performance [7-9].
label: none

sentence: Aerobic activity may influence executive function specifically [2,7-9].
label: none

sentence: The literature is consistent in reporting that increased time spent on physical education in schools has no detrimental effect on more 'academic' subjects and may even enhance academic attainment [10-13].
label: none

sentence: Higher levels of physical fitness in children may be associated with improved neurocognitive processing [12], and increased physical activity may enhance school 'on-task' behavior [13].
label: none

sentence: Increased physical activity may therefore provide cognitive and educational benefits across childhood and adolescence.
label: none

sentence: Experimental evidence in children is very limited [3,5]: < 1% of published exercise and cognition studies have involved child participants, and experimental evidence from pre-school children is absent.
label: none

sentence: There is therefore a need for randomized trials in children to establish definitively the presence of any cognitive effects of physical activity and to identify their nature (e.g.
label: none

sentence: dose-response effects; specificity to particular cognitive processes).
label: none

sentence: The UK Medical Research Council framework for complex interventions suggests that prior to carrying out full RCT it is important to carry out exploratory trials to examine: acceptability of study measurements; feasibility of the proposed trial; likely retention of participants and missing data [14].
label: none

sentence: The measurement of executive function is especially problematic in younger children [15].
label: none

sentence: Testing for effects of exercise on executive function in children is also problematic because of the difficulty of establishing exercise programs that effectively increase the levels of physical activity [16-18].
label: none

sentence: Carrying out well designed and adequately powered RCT to test for relationships between physical activity and executive function in young children therefore presents researchers with a number of major challenges.
label: none

sentence: Future RCT in this area will have to be informed by exploratory studies.
label: none

sentence: These studies need to establish which interventions are practical and what is the optimal 'dose' of physical activity.
label: none

sentence: They will also need to establish the practical utility and reliability of potential measures of executive function (outcome measures) in young children.
label: none

sentence: Finally, they will need to provide information on effect sizes to calculate sample size and ensure adequate power of future large scale RCT.
label: none

sentence: The present study therefore aimed to collect the data necessary to design and power a future school-based RCT on the influence of aerobic activity on executive function in 5-6 year olds.
label: none

sentence: All cognitive measures were specified a priori as candidate measures potentially sensitive to changes in physical activity.
label: none

sentence: A literature search and contact with experts in the field prior to the present study suggested three measures of cognition which might be suitable as candidate outcome measures for an RCT in young children: the Cognitive Assessment System (CAS;[19]); the Cambridge Neuropsychological Test Battery (CANTAB http://www.cantab.com); the Attention Network Test (ANT) [20].
label: none

sentence: All cognitive tests were administered to children individually in a quiet room in school using a laptop and touch-screen.
label: none

label: none

sentence: All children were tested by the same trained researcher (AF), seated comfortably approximately 53 cm from the laptop screen, and with the dominant hand resting on the computer mouse.
label: none

sentence: For a detailed description of the ANT see http://www.sacklerinstitute.org/users/jin.fan and Rueda et al [20], but in brief, the ANT was administered in four blocks of tests, each lasting approximately 5 minutes: a practice block of tests was used first to train the children in what was expected, and to identify any problems they had in performing the test (e.g.
label: none

label: none

sentence: After appearance of the fish on the laptop screen children were asked to press the right or left mouse button corresponding to the direction the fish was pointing.

sentence: The motor screening test involved the appearance of a pink cross on a black laptop screen and children were asked to touch the center of the cross with the dominant hand.
label: none

sentence: The SWM tests the number of items which can be held in working memory by asking participants to observe the laptop screen as a pattern of boxes appears, then to remember and replicate the pattern by touching boxes which are displayed on the screen.

sentence: Exploratory RCT results
label: none

sentence: Compliance of schools with the intervention and control PE was good - in all six schools all 20 of the 'prescribed' sessions were implemented (based on a diary kept by class teachers) during the 10 week study.
label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: Main findings and study implications
label: none

sentence: If causal links between physical activity, including PE, and cognition are established in children and adolescents then educators and policy makers may be more receptive to the promotion of physical activity.
label: none

sentence: Establishing such links will require evidence from experimental studies, and obtaining more definitive evidence of this kind will require exploratory trials upon which more definitive trials are based [14].
label: none

sentence: The present study suggests that the cognitive and behavioral measures used were practical in this sample and setting.
label: none

sentence: Each cognitive test battery was completed in less than 40 minutes and compliance with study procedures was generally high.
label: none

sentence: Reduced compliance with the Conner's Parents Rating Scale may have resulted from resource limitations of the present study (inability to send out second mailings to parents), or may indicate that this scale has low practical utility and may be unsuitable for future studies.
label: none

sentence: Reliability of the cognitive measures was more of a concern.
label: none

sentence: Reliability of the CANTAB and ANT scales, with intraclass correlations between 0.37 and 0.60, were lower than would generally be considered acceptable (29), and this may limit their usefulness as outcome measures in future RCT.
label: none

sentence: While empirical data from young children are scarce, effect sizes may be too small to be detectable with measures of the reliability observed in the present study [3,5,7].
label: none

sentence: The present study provides information sufficient to power future trials for a range of cognitive outcomes.
label: none

sentence: For example, the mean difference between groups in the CAS 'Planning' subscale was 7 with an SD of 15.
label: none

sentence: At 80% power and p = 0.05, a sample of 74 per group would be adequate to detect effects of a magnitude which could not be explained by test-retest differences in the CAS measure.
label: none

sentence: The intention in the present study was to develop a PE intervention that delivered around 40 minutes of MVPA within every hour-long PE session, and in this respect the pilot study was not successful.
label: none

sentence: Future RCT should reduce the amount of time children spend not moving during PE, and increase the amount of MVPA.
label: none

sentence: In the study by Davis et al [2] a high intensity of physical activity was achieved by a well chosen activity program, the use of real time heart-rate data to provide feedback on the intensity of physical activity, and the presence of a number of research assistants to instruct each class.
label: none

sentence: These characteristics of the study by Davis et al [2] ensured high fidelity to the prescribed dose of physical activity, but would present challenges to translation of the intervention to the school or after-school setting.
label: none

sentence: The ability to develop and implement an enhanced PE intervention is likely to be critical to any future RCT in this area.
label: none

sentence: Previous studies have noted repeatedly that levels of physical activity during PE are often very low, and have also noted the difficulty in producing sustained increases in intensity of physical activity during PE in children [11,16-18,32].
label: none

sentence: An essential part of process evaluation of future RCT will be to examine whether or not the 'prescribed' levels of physical activity are actually being reached by children: accelerometry was adequate for this purpose but did not provide teachers or children with real time feedback on the intensity of PE.
label: none

sentence: Comparisons with other evidence
label: none

sentence: The present studies are not directly comparable with other literature, though the RCT of an after-school based physical activity intervention in sedentary overweight and obese older children and adolescents by Davis et al [2] is the most readily comparable study.
label: none

sentence: When designing the present study, outcome data from Davis et al.
label: none

sentence: were not available, and even if they had been available their generalisability to children who were on average more than three years younger was unclear.
label: none

sentence: There was no guidance on how intense, and how frequent an intervention for a younger age group should be in terms of enhancing cognitive function, or what would be acceptable to primary schools in a different population.
label: none

sentence: Study Limitations
label: none

sentence: While sample sizes in the studies described here were relatively small, they were adequate to examine reliability and practical utility of the outcome measures chosen, were adequate for an exploratory RCT, and sufficient to power more definitive RCT in future.
label: limitation

sentence: The number of tests carried out will have increased the probability of significant differences being observed by chance.
label: limitation

sentence: It should also be noted that some of the significant differences which favored the intervention group in the present study were observed with small sample sizes and with outcome measures which had low reliability (e.g.
label: limitation

sentence: ANT accuracy) -the results of the current study should therefore be viewed with caution.
label: none

sentence: In the present study we lacked the resources to assess the reliability of the CAS, which required administration by psychologists, and at the time of the study we depended on a single study to support the view that reliability of the CAS was high.
label: none

sentence: Naglieri and Das [19] measured reliability of the CAS in a nationally representative sample of 872 US children and adolescents, age 5-17 years, and reliabilities of all CAS subscales in all age groups ranged from 0.83-0.93 [19].
label: none

sentence: An assessment of the reliability of the CAS in our sample and setting would have been helpful, and reasons why the reliability of CANTAB and ANT were lower in the present study than reliability previously reported for the CAS are unclear.
label: none

sentence: While time spent in MVPA was significantly higher in the intervention than in the control group PE classes, both spent a large proportion of time sedentary.
label: none

sentence: Several biologically plausible mechanisms link physical activity and cognition [4,6,33] but identifying these in future larger-scale and longer-term RCT may require a greater contrast in the 'dose' of physical activity between experimental and control groups.
label: none

sentence: Additional research on the nature of existing PE-before the present study intervention-would have been helpful in designing a PE program which was more physically active.
label: none

sentence: A further difficulty arises from lack of certainty in the optimal accelerometry cut-points.
label: none

sentence: With lower cut-points than those used in the present study levels of apparent MVPA would have been higher, and levels of apparent sedentary behavior lower, in both the intervention and control groups [24].
label: none

sentence: The present study was designed with longer-term translation to school systems in mind (the rationale for choosing PE as the means of delivering the physical activity intervention).
label: none

sentence: However, any longer-term translation of this sort of intervention to schools would need to be informed by evidence which the present study did not address, such as needs assessments and qualitative studies with teachers and school pupils.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: The cognitive and behavioral effects of increases in physical activity in children merit greater emphasis in research because of the enormous potential for short and long term academic and health benefits [33].
label: none

sentence: The greater degree of neural plasticity of young children means that they may have most to gain from increased physical activity, but studying physical activity-cognition relationships in young children is especially challenging.
label: none

sentence: The present studies have provided evidence that should inform the future RCT which will be necessary in order to better understand relationships between physical activity and cognition in young children in future.

sentence: Immunosuppression for progressive membranous nephropathy: a UK randomised controlled trial
label: none

sentence: Summary
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Membranous nephropathy leads to end-stage renal disease in more than 20% of patients.
label: none

sentence: Although immunosuppressive therapy benefits some patients, trial evidence for the subset of patients with declining renal function is not available.
label: none

sentence: We aimed to assess whether immunosuppression preserves renal function in patients with idiopathic membranous nephropathy with declining renal function.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: This randomised controlled trial was undertaken in 37 renal units across the UK.
label: none

sentence: We recruited patients (18–75 years) with biopsy-proven idiopathic membranous nephropathy, a plasma creatinine concentration of less than 300 μmol/L, and at least a 20% decline in excretory renal function measured in the 2 years before study entry, based on at least three measurements over a period of 3 months or longer.
label: none

sentence: Patients were randomly assigned (1:1:1) by a random number table to receive supportive treatment only, supportive treatment plus 6 months of alternating cycles of prednisolone and chlorambucil, or supportive treatment plus 12 months of ciclosporin.
label: none

sentence: The primary outcome was a further 20% decline in renal function from baseline, analysed by intention to treat.
label: none

sentence: The trial is registered as an International Standard Randomised Controlled Trial, number 99959692.
label: none

sentence: Findings
label: none

sentence: We randomly assigned 108 patients, 33 of whom received prednisolone and chlorambucil, 37 ciclosporin, and 38 supportive therapy alone.
label: none

sentence: Two patients (one who received ciclosporin and one who received supportive therapy) were ineligible, so were not included in the intention-to-treat analysis, and 45 patients deviated from protocol before study end, mostly as a result of minor dose adjustments.
label: none

sentence: Follow up was until primary endpoint or for minimum of 3 years if primary endpoint was not reached.
label: none

sentence: Risk of further 20% decline in renal function was significantly lower in the prednisolone and chlorambucil group than in the supportive care group (19 [58%] of 33 patients reached endpoint vs 31 [84%] of 37, hazard ratio [HR] 0·44 [95% CI 0·24–0·78]; p=0·0042); risk did not differ between the ciclosporin (29 [81%] of 36) and supportive treatment only groups (HR 1·17 [0·70–1·95]; p=0·54), but did differ significantly across all three groups (p=0·003).
label: none

sentence: Serious adverse events were frequent in all three groups but were higher in the prednisolone and chlorambucil group than in the supportive care only group (56 events vs 24 events; p=0·048).
label: none

sentence: Interpretation
label: none

sentence: For the subset of patients with idiopathic membranous nephropathy and deteriorating excretory renal function, 6 months' therapy with prednisolone and chlorambucil is the treatment approach best supported by our evidence.
label: none

sentence: Ciclosporin should be avoided in this subset.
label: none

sentence: Funding
label: none

sentence: Medical Research Council, Novartis, Renal Association, Kidney Research UK.
label: none

sentence: Introduction
label: none

sentence: Membranous nephropathy is the most common cause of primary nephrotic syndrome in adults, and according to figures from the Netherlands, 30–50 people per million population develop the disorder every 5 years (6–10 per million population per year).
label: none

sentence: Membranous nephropathy results in substantial morbidity and is an important cause of end-stage renal disease, which accounted for expenditure of US$40 billion in the USA in 2008.
label: none

sentence: Optimum treatment for membranous nephropathy is controversial despite several controlled trials having assessed available treatments, not least because the disorder has a variable natural history and many severely affected individuals can undergo spontaneous remission.
label: none

sentence: Only a subset of patients (25–30% in most series) develops progressive loss of kidney function, and since available therapies have substantial adverse effects, some believe that aggressive therapy should be reserved for this subgroup.
label: none

sentence: However, no large prospective randomised controlled trials (RCTs) in this worst-affected subset exist.
label: none

sentence: Studies of the natural history of membranous nephropathy show that once excretory renal function starts to decline, continued deterioration can be expected, which suggests that the really important clinical question in membranous nephropathy is whether treatments that are effective in less severely affected patients are also beneficial in patients showing definite signs of decline in renal function.
label: none

sentence: Thus, findings from prospective RCTs are essential to inform decisions about treatment of this disorder.
label: none

sentence: Idiopathic membranous nephropathy is often managed with immunosuppressive drugs.
label: none

sentence: Until recently, evidence that this nephropathy is autoimmune in origin was circumstantial.
label: none

sentence: However, autoantibodies to the phospholipase A2 receptor (PLA2R1) have now been noted in most affected individuals, and a predisposition to the disorder has been very strongly linked to two genetic regions (one in the MHC and the other in the PLA2R1 gene itself)—findings that support an immunological pathogenesis and provide a rationale for immunosuppressive therapy, especially treatment targeted at B lymphocytes.
label: none

sentence: When our study was designed, combined treatment with prednisolone and chlorambucil and single-agent therapy with ciclosporin were supported by RCT evidence.
label: none

sentence: We did a questionnaire survey as part of our preliminary research and noted that nephrologists were uncertain about the relative risks of intervention with immunosuppressive therapy compared with supportive therapy alone.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, we aimed to test the hypothesis that immunosuppressive therapy, either with prednisolone and chlorambucil or with ciclosporin, preserves renal function in patients with idiopathic membranous nephropathy with declining renal function compared with supportive therapy alone.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: Trial design and participants
label: none

sentence: In this randomised controlled trial, patients were recruited from 37 of 45 renal units in acute hospitals throughout the UK that obtained local ethical approval.
label: none

sentence: Inclusion criteria were: age 18–75 years; biopsy-proven diagnosis of membranous nephropathy (we did not impose a limit on the time since biopsy), regarded as idiopathic with no evidence of an underlying cause (such as drugs, infections, or tumours); and serum or plasma creatinine concentration of less than 300 μmol/L together with a 20% or greater decline in excretory renal function (measured by creatinine clearance or estimated with the Cockcroft-Gault calculation, and later by the Modification of Diet in Renal Disease [MDRD] formula) that was based on at least three measurements over a period of 3 months or longer within the 2 years before study entry.
label: none

sentence: We excluded patients whose membranous nephropathy was a result of secondary causes (defined according to usual clinical practice).
label: none

sentence: Other exclusion criteria were: known infection with hepatitis B or C virus or HIV; known malignant disease; positive antibodies to double-stranded DNA; current treatment with gold, penicillamine, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, cytotoxic drugs, or ciclosporin; more than 3 months' treatment with corticosteroids in the preceding 2 years; pregnancy or unreliable contraception; or a previous adverse reaction to prednisolone, methylprednisolone, chlorambucil or ciclosporin.
label: none

sentence: Ethics approval was obtained from the South West Multicentre Research Ethics Committee (reference MREC/97/6/12).
label: none

sentence: Each participating centre also obtained local ethical approval.
label: none

sentence: All patients gave written informed consent.
label: none

sentence: Randomisation
label: none

sentence: Eligible patients were randomly assigned by a member of staff in the clinical trials office at the Glasgow Royal Infirmary, Glasgow, UK, who was not otherwise involved in the trial.
label: none

sentence: A random numbers table had been prepared to allocate patients to one of three groups: supportive therapy alone, supportive therapy plus 6 months of prednisolone and chlorambucil, or supportive therapy plus 12 months of ciclosporin.
label: none

sentence: Treatment allocation was communicated by fax to the clinician entering the patient into the trial.
label: none

sentence: We did not attempt to mask patients or investigators.
label: none

sentence: Procedures
label: none

sentence: We recorded baseline data for the supportive treatment alone group at randomisation, because these patients were effectively continuing their existing management.
label: none

sentence: In the two groups receiving immunosuppressive treatment in addition to supportive therapy, baseline data were recorded when the new treatment began.
label: none

sentence: We could not always start immunosuppressive treatment immediately after randomisation because the new treatments had to be prescribed and delivered.
label: none

sentence: The treatment schedules were based on best available evidence at the time.
label: none

sentence: All patients received supportive therapy, including renin-angiotensin blockade, statins, and anticoagulants as indicated.
label: none

sentence: Those assigned to supportive therapy plus 6 months' prednisolone and chorambucil received intravenous methyl prednisolone 1 g per day for 3 consecutive days then oral prednisolone 0·5 mg/kg per day for 28 days during months 1, 3, and 5.
label: none

sentence: Intravenous prednisolone was administered in hospital.
label: none

sentence: During months 2, 4, and 6, patients received oral chlorambucil at a starting dose of 0·15 mg/kg per day.
label: none

sentence: We gave this reduced dose because the parent drug and its metabolites are renally excreted and our preliminary work had shown that a dose of 0·2 mg/kg per day was poorly tolerated in patients with impaired excretory renal function.
label: none

sentence: We reduced the dose further if the patient developed leucopenia (weekly full blood counts were advised) and interrupted it if leucopenia was severe.
label: none

sentence: Those assigned to supportive therapy plus 12 months' of ciclosporin received a starting dose of 5 mg/kg per day, adjusted according to trough blood concentrations of the drug to achieve a concentration of 100–200 μg/L.
label: none

sentence: We reduced the dose if toxicity was evident.
label: none

sentence: We followed up patients until they met the primary endpoint, or for a minimum of 3 years if they did not do so.
label: none

sentence: The trial was not formally analysed until 3 years after all patients had begun treatment.
label: none

sentence: All surviving trial patients remain under routine follow-up at their renal units.
label: none

sentence: The primary endpoint was a further 20% decline in excretory renal function from baseline readings, calculated in all patients with the Cockcroft-Gault equation (standard methodology at the start of the trial).
label: none

sentence: Secondary endpoints were proteinuria (measured with 24-h urinary collections or estimated from protein–creatinine ratios by multiplying the ratio [in mg/mmol] by 10) and severe adverse events.
label: none

sentence: The primary investigator (PWM) identified which adverse events were serious and categorised them according to the most affected body system.
label: none

sentence: We report all serious adverse events as defined by the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) guidance—(ie, any adverse event, adverse reaction, or unexpected adverse reaction that results in death, is life-threatening, results in admission to hospital or extends the length of an existing hospital stay, results in persistent or serious disability or incapacity, or consists of a congenital anomaly or birth defect).
label: none

sentence: We also regarded as serious other important medical events that might have jeopardised the patient or needed intervention to prevent one of these outcomes.
label: none

sentence: We recorded information about deaths and development of end-stage renal disease.
label: none

sentence: In accordance with the Medical Research Council's guidelines for good clinical practice, a trial steering committee and a data monitoring committee were established to receive yearly reports for primary endpoints, adverse events, and deaths.
label: none

sentence: Statistical analysis
label: none

sentence: To have 90% power to detect a reduction in frequency of the primary endpoint from 80% in the supportive treatment group to 40% in the immunosuppression groups with p<0·05, we calculated that 35 patients would be needed in each group (105 in total).
label: none

sentence: After allowing for an estimated dropout rate of 10%, we concluded that we needed to recruit 116 patients.
label: none

sentence: Primary analysis followed the principles of intention to treat, and secondary analysis assessed all patients who received at least one dose of treatment.
label: none

sentence: Unless otherwise stated, p values and estimates of treatment effects are based on two-way comparisons.
label: none

sentence: We did not make adjustments for multiple comparisons.
label: none

sentence: We analysed time to further 20% decline in renal function by the log-rank test and calculated hazard ratios [HRs] with Cox proportional hazards regression.
label: none

sentence: We used the log-rank test for other survival endpoints, and repeated measures analysis of variance fowr continuous longitudinal data (eg, proteinuria).
label: none

sentence: We analysed serious adverse event data with the log-rank test on the basis of time to first serious adverse event.
label: none

sentence: We did statistical analyses using SAS software (version 9.2).
label: none

sentence: In 2003, the trial was shown to comply with the requirements of the EU clinical trials directive, and in 2004, a clinical trial authorisation (CTA) was obtained from the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Authority (CTA number 18524/0001/001).
label: none

sentence: In 2008, the trial was adopted onto the National Institute for Health Research portfolio and assigned the UK Clinical Research Network identification number 2579.
label: none

sentence: The trial is registered as an International Standard Randomised Controlled Trial, number 99959692.
label: none

sentence: Role of the funding source
label: none

sentence: The sponsors of the study had no role in study design, data collection, data analysis, data interpretation, or writing of the report.
label: none

sentence: The corresponding author had full access to all the data in the study and had final responsibility to submit for publication.

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: We randomly assigned 108 patients between April 1, 1998, and March 31, 2008, at a steady rate of about one patient per month (figure 1).
label: none

sentence: We discovered that two patients were ineligible after randomisation, so no follow-up data are available for them, and they weren't included in the primary analysis.
label: none

sentence: Of the 106 patients included in the intention-to-treat analysis, 37 were assigned to receive supportive therapy alone, 33 to prednisolone and chlorambucil, and 36 to ciclosporin.
label: none

sentence: 37 of the 45 centres that obtained ethics approval entered patients into the trial.
label: none

sentence: The groups had similar baseline measurements (table 1).
label: none

sentence: Times between randomisation and baseline readings are longer in both immunosuppressive groups than in the supportive therapy alone group because of delays relating to prescription, delivery, and administration of treatment.
label: none

sentence: We classed deviations from the defined protocol, including starting dose of intervention drugs, as either minor (eg, dose reductions because of toxicity) or major (eg, cessation of treatment, including temporary interruptions, or administration of the wrong treatment).
label: none

sentence: We did not classify a delay between randomisation and start of treatment as a default protocol deviation.
label: none

sentence: However, two patients had excessive delays (2 and 3 months, respectively), and we classified both as major deviations.
label: none

sentence: Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor was given to 27 (82%) of 33 in the prednisolone and chlorambucil group, 36 (100%) of 36 patients in the ciclosporin group, and 34 (92%) of 37 of those who received supportive treatment only.
label: none

sentence: We did not obtain information about angiotensin-receptor antagonist use.
label: none

sentence: The rate of occurrence of a further 20% decline in excretory renal function from baseline was fastest in the ciclosporin group and slowest in the prednisolone and chlorambucil group (figure 2).
label: none

sentence: Risk of a further 20% decline in renal function was significantly lower in the prednisolone and chlorambucil group than in the supportive therapy group (19 [58%] of 33 patients vs 31 [84%] of 37 patients, HR 0·44 [95% CI 0·24–0·78]; p=0·0042), with no significant difference noted between the ciclosporin group (29 [81%] of 36 patients) and supportive care group (HR 1·17 [0·70–1·95]; p=0·54).
label: none

sentence: The difference in the proportion of patients who reached the primary endpoint across all three groups was significant (p=0·003 for the three-way comparison; figure 2).
label: none

sentence: Survival analysis showed no significant differences between groups: two (6·1%) of 33 patients in the prednisolone plus chlorambucil group died during the trial follow-up compared with two (5·6%) of 36 patients in the ciclosporin group and one (2·7%) of 37 in the supportive therapy group.
label: none

sentence: We did not classify any deaths as likely to be related to trial treatments.
label: none

sentence: Of the five deaths, two were due to myocardial infarction (one each in the prednisolone plus chlorambucil and ciclosporin groups), one to septicaemia (in the supportive treatment only group), and two to unknown causes.
label: none

sentence: Malignant disease was reported in two (6·1%) of 33 patients in the prednisolone plus chlorambucil group during follow-up: one had squamous-cell carcinoma of the skin and one had adenocarcinoma of the sigmoid colon.
label: none

sentence: 11 patients reached end-stage renal disease: one (3·0%) of 33 in the prednisolone plus chlorambucil group compared with six (16·7%) of 36 in the ciclosporin group and four (10·8%) of 37 in the supportive therapy group.
label: none

sentence: The fall in proteinuria with time was greatest in the prednisolone plus chlorambucil group (figure 3).
label: none

sentence: The difference in the mean reduction of protein in the urine for prednisolone and chlorambucil versus supportive therapy alone was −2·2 g in 24 h (p=0·014).
label: none

sentence: The difference in the mean reduction for ciclosporin versus supportive care alone was −0·7 g in 24 h (p=0·46).
label: none

sentence: We recorded 390 adverse events, of which 117 were deemed serious by PWM.
label: none

sentence: These 117 events occurred in 54 patients (table 2).
label: none

sentence: The number of patients with a serious adverse event by 1 year did not differ significantly between the ciclosporin and supportive care groups (17 [46%] of 37 patients in the ciclosporin group vs 11 [29%] of 38 in the supportive therapy only group; p=0·20), but the number of patients in the prednisolone and chlorambucil group with a serious adverse event by 1 year (17 [52%] of 33 patients) was significantly higher than in the supportive care group (p=0·048).
label: none

sentence: Haematological events were leucopenia, anaemia, and thrombocytopenia, although we did not note any lymphomas or leukaemias.
label: none

sentence: Dermatological effects included rash and shingles.
label: none

sentence: Renal effects were mainly deterioration of excretory renal function or hyperkalaemia.
label: none

sentence: Neurological effects were tremor and headache.
label: none

sentence: Cardiovascular effects were hypertension, myocardial infarction, chest pain, and pulmonary embolus.
label: none

sentence: Metabolic effects included impairment of glucose tolerance.
label: none

sentence: Gastroenterological effects included nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, bleeding, and pancreatitis.
label: none

sentence: Infection included septicaemia, pneumonia, and cellulitis.
label: none

sentence: Other effects included cataract, fractured humerus, hernia repairs, and pulmonary sarcoid.
label: none

sentence: We acknowledge that some potential adverse effects of prednisolone plus chlorambucil and ciclosporin are more longlasting than the effects reported with supportive care alone, especially the risk of lymphoma or other malignant diseases.
label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

label: none

label: none

sentence: We conducted a double-blind placebo-controlled randomized trial to evaluate the effect of high-dose prenatal 3rd trimester vitamin D3 supplementation on maternal and neonatal (cord blood) serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25(OH)D) concentration (primary biochemical efficacy outcome) and maternal serum calcium concentration (primary safety measure).
label: none

label: none

sentence: 160 women were randomized by 1:1 allocation to one of two parallel intervention groups; placebo (n = 80) or 35,000 IU/week of vitamin D3 (n = 80) until delivery.
label: none

sentence: All participants, study personnel and study investigators were blind to treatment allocation.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: Mean maternal 25(OH)D concentration was similar in the vitamin D and placebo groups at baseline (45 vs. 44 nmol/L; p = 0.66), but was significantly higher in the vitamin D group vs. placebo group among mothers at delivery (134 vs. 38 nmol/L; p < 0.001) and newborns (cord blood: 103 vs. 39; p < 0.001).
label: none

sentence: In the vitamin D group, 95% of neonates and 100% of mothers attained 25(OH)D >50 nmol/L, versus 21% mothers and 19% of neonates in the placebo group.
label: none

sentence: No participants met criteria for hypercalcemia, there were no known supplement-related adverse events, and major pregnancy outcomes were similar between groups.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: Antenatal 3rd-trimester vitamin D3 supplementation (35,000 IU/week) significantly raised maternal and cord serum 25(OH)D concentrations above 50 nmol/L in almost all participants without inducing hypercalcemia or other observed safety concerns.
label: none

sentence: Doses up to 35,000 IU/week may be cautiously used in further research aimed at establishing the clinical effects and safety of vitamin D3 supplementation in pregnancy.

label: none

sentence: Vitamin D status during pregnancy has been proposed to influence the risk of gestational diabetes and hypertensive diseases of pregnancy [1], fetal skeletal growth [2], brain development [3], and neonatal immune function [4].
label: none

sentence: The major circulating vitamin D metabolite, 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25(OH)D), crosses the placenta from the maternal to the fetal circulation, thereby establishing fetal-neonatal vitamin D stores [5].
label: none

sentence: However, the effects of vitamin D on maternal, placental or fetal tissues are uncertain [2], and the extent to which health outcomes are responsive to changes in maternal-fetal vitamin D status remains unknown [2,6,7].
label: none

sentence: Currently, there is insufficient evidence to either support or refute the benefits of any given supplemental vitamin D dose during pregnancy [8,9].
label: none

sentence: Moreover, the safety of high-dose prenatal vitamin D regimens (i.e., doses that substantially exceed the conventional prenatal intake of 400 to 600 IU/day) has yet to be established [6].
label: none

sentence: The Institute of Medicine (IOM) Committee to Review Dietary Reference Intakes (DRIs) for Vitamin D and Calcium concluded in 2010 that the recommended dietary allowance (RDA) of 600 IU/day and tolerable upper intake level (UL) of 4000 IU/day for non-pregnant adults were suitable for pregnant women [7].

label: none

sentence: Uncertainty surrounding vitamin D requirements in pregnancy has led to divergent dose recommendations; for example, the UNICEF antenatal micronutrient formulation contains 200 IU/day [11], the Canadian Paediatric Society has suggested 2000 IU/day [12], and Hollis et al.

sentence: Data were visualized using cross-sectional density plots and longitudinal scatterplots with locally weighted regression (lowess), and described by means, standard deviations (SD) and 95% confidence intervals (95% CI), or median and interquartile range (IQR) for variables with skewed distributions.
label: none

sentence: Analyses at 'delivery' were based on specimens collected within +/− 1 day of delivery.
label: none

sentence: Urinary ca:cr at two weeks after enrollment was based on specimens collected 14 +/−1 days after the first supplement dose.
label: none

sentence: Between-group differences in the mean maternal and cord serum 25(OH)D, maternal Ca, adj-Ca, and PTH, and maternal urinary ca:cr were analyzed at baseline and delivery using linear regression for cross-sectional comparisons and generalized estimating equations (GEE) for between-group differences in changes from baseline to delivery (to account for within-person correlation of paired measures).
label: none

sentence: PTH and urinary ca:cr were log and square-root transformed, respectively, to approximate normality for parametric tests.
label: none

sentence: Bootstrapping was employed to confirm the robustness of inferences.
label: none

sentence: In per-protocol sensitivity analyses, we only included participants who received at least 8 consecutive weekly supplement doses and for whom delivery serum specimens were available.
label: none

sentence: Change in mean 25(OH)D over time was modeled as a continuous non-linear parametric function using a negative exponential growth function [16].
label: none

sentence: This approach enabled the estimation of the average difference in 25(OH)D between the two groups at a presumed ‘steady-state’ (i.e., where group-averaged 25(OH)D did not continue to appreciably rise despite ongoing vitamin D supplementation).
label: none

sentence: As a per-protocol sensitivity analysis, change in mean 25(OH)D over time was modeled as a function of cumulative dose (micrograms) of vitamin D actually administered.
label: none

sentence: Changes in serum Ca, adj-Ca, ca:cr, and PTH concentrations were modeled longitudinally using GEE with exchangeable correlation and robust variance estimation.
label: none

sentence: Serum Ca, adj-Ca and urine ca:cr demonstrated non-linear trends over time in visual analysis by lowess plots; therefore, piecewise (spline) linear regressions were employed, with knot placement (the point on the x-axis where the piecewise regression functions join) for ca:cr ratio at day 14 (timing of scheduled urine collection) and at day 60 for serum Ca and adj-Ca.
label: none

sentence: Knot placement was based on visual assessment of the trend indicated by the lowess functions.
label: none

sentence: In sensitivity analyses, variation in knot placement did not change the inferences of the model coefficients (data not shown).
label: none

sentence: Clinical outcomes were compared between groups using Student’s t-test or Chi-square and Fischer’s exact test.
label: none

sentence: Frequencies of reported symptoms or minor clinical adverse events, based on weekly clinical monitoring, were analyzed using GEE where appropriate to estimate between-group differences.
label: none

sentence: Given the large number of individual symptoms, the Holm procedure was used to correct for multiplicity of pair-wise comparisons [23].
label: none

sentence: Data were entered in an electronic database (SQL Server 2005) using a custom-designed interface (Visual Basic 6).
label: none

sentence: Built-in range and consistency checks were employed in the data capture system to prevent errors in data entry.
label: none

sentence: Analyses were conducted using Stata version 11 (Stata Corporation, College Station, Texas) and R version 2.15.1 (R Foundation for Statistical Computing, Vienna, Austria).
label: none

sentence: The target sample size was 160 pregnant women, to enable detection of a 0.5 SD difference in the primary outcome (serum 25(OH)D concentration at delivery), with a risk of a type I error rate (alpha) of 0.05, 80% power, and accounting for up to 20% attrition prior to delivery.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: Of the 160 participants recruited and randomly assigned to either vitamin D (35,000 IU/week) or placebo, 13 were lost to follow-up prior to delivery (6 in the placebo group and 7 in the Vitamin D group), all because of having left the Dhaka area (Figure 1).
label: none

sentence: Serum specimens were available for all participants at baseline and for 130 (81.3%) participants (63 placebo, 67 vitamin D) at delivery.
label: none

sentence: Cord blood specimens were collected from 67 and 65 mother-infant pairs in the placebo and vitamin D groups, respectively.
label: none

sentence: Maternal characteristics and 25(OH)D at baseline were similar in the placebo and vitamin D groups (Tables 1 and 2).
label: none

sentence: Weekly supplementation occurred over a median period of approximately 10 weeks in both groups, and adherence was excellent among participants who contributed biochemical outcome data (Table 3).
label: none

sentence: Most participants in both groups were vitamin D insufficient by the IOM threshold (25(OH)D <50 nmol/L) at baseline (Table 2).
label: none

sentence: Vitamin D status at baseline did not differ between the supplementation groups (Table 4) nor between participants with and without delivery specimens (44.5 vs. 44.8 nmol/L, p = 0.94).
label: none

sentence: Vitamin D supplementation had a substantial, statistically significant effect on maternal and neonatal vitamin D status at the time of delivery, as reflected in the overall 25(OH)D distributions (Figure 2; Table 4) as well as the proportion of participants considered to have low 25(OH)D using cut-offs (Table 2).
label: none

sentence: Notably, 100% of mothers (at delivery) and 95% of neonates attained 25(OH)D >50 nmol/L compared to only 21% and 19% of mother and neonates, respectively, in the placebo group (Table 2).
label: none

sentence: The highest 25(OH)D value in any participant was 200 nmol/L, observed in a vitamin D group participant at delivery; concurrently, her other biochemistry were normal (adj-Ca, 2.47 mmol/L; urine ca:cr, 0.23 mmol/mmol).
label: none

sentence: Longitudinal analysis of the change in mean 25(OH)D over time revealed an early and rapid rise in 25(OH)D, with a steady-state approached after about 2 months of supplementation (Figure 3; Table 5).
label: none

sentence: As evidence that this plateau was not an artifact of diminishing supplement adherence over time, a sensitivity analysis in which 25(OH)D was modeled as a function of cumulative vitamin D dose revealed the same pattern (Figure 3), and fit the data well (Table 5).
label: none

sentence: Vitamin D status declined in the placebo group over time (Figure 3), but was not significantly lower at delivery compared to baseline (38.3 vs. 44.0, p = 0.09).
label: none

sentence: Given the substantial inter-individual variability in the response to vitamin D supplementation (Figure 3), we explored the role of the following potential modifiers of the magnitude of the change in 25(OH)D (Δ25(OH)D) from baseline to delivery (selected a priori): maternal weight at baseline, maternal age, gestational age, maternal body mass index at baseline (BMI), gravidity, parity, baseline PTH status, season and baseline vitamin D status.
label: none

sentence: None of these factors explained significant inter-individual variability in the change in 25(OH)D status (data not shown).
label: none

sentence: Although Δ25(OH)D was inversely associated with baseline vitamin D status, and about 24% of the variance in Δ25(OH)D in the vitamin D group was explained by baseline 25(OH)D, this association appeared to be due to regression to the mean, since similar trends were observed in both the vitamin D and placebo groups.
label: none

sentence: As expected, we found a strong correlation between maternal delivery and cord 25(OH)D (Pearson correlation = 0.87, p < 0.001), yet there was substantial variability among mother-infant pairs with respect to the cord-to-maternal ratio (ranged from 0.24 to 3.93).
label: none

sentence: Notably, variation in cord 25(OH)D within the vitamin D group was not associated with duration of supplementation (p = 0.86) or cumulative vitamin D supplement dose administered (p = 0.93), indicating that the maternal-fetal vitamin D equilibrium was achieved rapidly.
label: none

sentence: Mean maternal adj-Ca concentration rose over time within the reference range; the initial rate of rise appeared to be greater in the vitamin D group, but the difference was attenuated after ~2 months of supplementation (Figure 4).
label: none

sentence: The mean adj-Ca at delivery and the change in this parameter from baseline to delivery were slightly but significantly greater in the vitamin D group versus placebo (Table 4; Figure 5).
label: none

sentence: Conversely, the between-group differences in the mean total unadjusted serum Ca concentration at delivery and the change from baseline to delivery were of lower magnitude and not significant (Table 4).
label: none

sentence: There were no cases of hypercalcemia in either group, defined a priori as adj-Ca >2.60 nmol/L on two separate consecutive blood specimens.
label: none

sentence: One participant in the vitamin D group exhibited an isolated adj-Ca value of 2.62 mmol/L at the time of delivery, in the context of an acute diarrheal illness.
label: none

sentence: Repeat measurements were 2.45 mmol/L on both days 3 and 12 postpartum (see Additional file 2: Table S3 for biochemical adverse events at any time during follow-up); therefore, trial criteria for hypercalcemia were not met.
label: none

sentence: This participant’s unadjusted total serum Ca measurements were 2.48 mmol/L at delivery, 2.19 mmo/L at 3 days postpartum, and 2.41 mmol/L at 12 days postpartum.
label: none

sentence: Her calcium:creatinine ratio ranged from 0.02 to 0.22 mmol/mmol and 25(OH)D ranged from 22 to 118 nmol/L.
label: none

sentence: In secondary post-hoc analyses using all maternal serum specimens in which 25(OH)D and calcium were measured simultaneously, adj-Ca was significantly associated with 25(OH)D at 25(OH)D < 100 nmol/L (0.02 mmol/L [95% CI: 0.01, 0.03] increase in adj-Ca per 25 nmol/L increase in 25(OH)D below 100 nmol/L; n = 331), but this association was nullified and non-significant at 25(OH)D > =100 nmol/L (−0.01 mmol/L [95% CI: -0.02, 0.01] per 25 nmol/L increase in 25(OH)D above 100 nmol/L; n = 102).
label: none

sentence: Urinary ca:cr rose marginally in both groups after the first two weeks of supplementation, but declined thereafter (Figure 4).
label: none

sentence: Changes over time were similar in both groups (Figure 4), and there were no significant differences in ca:cr between the two groups at delivery (Table 4; Figure 5).
label: none

sentence: Hypercalciuria, defined a priori as ca:cr >1.0 mmol/mmol on 2 consecutive separate occasions, occurred in one participant in the vitamin D group, at 29 weeks gestation on day 14 of follow-up.
label: none

sentence: Ca:cr was 1.08 mmol/mmol on day 14 and 1.11 mmol/mmol on day 16, but was normal at delivery (0.23 mmol/mmol) after continuation of vitamin D supplementation for a total of 10 weeks (cumulative dose of 9625 mcg).
label: none

sentence: Throughout follow-up, this participant’s adj-Ca was within the reference range (2.32 to 2.55 mmol/L) and 25(OH)D concentration ranged from 54 – 147 nmol/L.
label: none

sentence: A renal ultrasound showed an absence of nephrocalcinosis or renal calculi, and there were no associated clinical consequences.
label: none

sentence: Transient hypercalciuria, defined as one ca:cr measurement above 1.0 mmol/mmol, was observed in 3 (4.1%) participants in the placebo group and 4 (5.5%) in the vitamin D group (p = 0.72 for between-group difference).
label: none

sentence: Similarly, the proportion of participants with a ca:cr >0.8 mmol/mmol and >2-fold difference from baseline did not differ significantly between the two groups (2.7% vs. 5.5%, p = 0.44).
label: none

sentence: Vitamin D supplementation had a significant suppressive effect on maternal PTH concentration, such that the rise in PTH observed in the placebo group was completely attenuated in the vitamin D group (Figure 4), and the average PTH concentration was lower in the vitamin D group at delivery (Figure 2; Table 4).
label: none

sentence: Detailed weekly clinical monitoring did not reveal significant differences in reported symptom or minor adverse event frequencies between the two groups (online supplemental material).
label: none

sentence: In particular, the overall proportion of encounters in which there was at least one symptom possibly suggestive of hypercalcemia was similar for the placebo and vitamin D groups (54% vs. 53%, p = 0.71; analysis accounted for repeated events within the same participants).
label: none

sentence: Major pregnancy/birth outcome and serious clinical adverse event frequencies and distributions were similar across the two groups (Table 6).
label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: Among pregnant women with relatively low average baseline vitamin D status in Dhaka, 3rd-trimester vitamin D3 supplementation (35,000 IU/week) significantly raised maternal and neonatal (cord blood) serum 25(OH)D concentrations above the IOM cut-off for sufficiency (50 nmol/L) in virtually all participants without inducing hypercalcemia or other apparent short-term clinical adverse effects.
label: none

sentence: This study contributes pharmacokinetic data relevant to South Asia, as well as preliminary evidence in support of a vitamin D3 no observed adverse effect level (NOAEL) of 35,000 IU/week in the third trimester of pregnancy.
label: none

sentence: The present findings build primarily on those of Hollis et al.
label: none

sentence: in South Carolina, who randomized 502 pregnant women at 12 to 16 weeks gestation to receive vitamin D3 at doses of 400 IU/day, 2000 IU/day, or 4000 IU/day; 350 participants (70%) were followed-up until delivery [13].
label: none

sentence: From a baseline 25(OH)D of 58 nmol/L, 2000 IU/day and 4000 IU/day raised 25(OH)D to means at the time of delivery of 98 nmol/L (rise of 40 nmol/L) and 111 nmol/L (rise of 52 nmol/L), respectively [13].
label: none

sentence: In the 4000 IU/day group, 82% attained 80 nmol/L at delivery, compared to 97% in the present study (5000 IU/day).
label: none

sentence: In 2012, Dawodu et al.
label: none

sentence: presented unpublished findings from a trial in United Arab Emirates in which 2000 IU/day and 4000 IU/day raised mean 25(OH)D from ~20 nmol/L to ~65 nmol/L (rise of 45 nmol/L) and ~90 nmol/L (rise of 70 nmol/L) at delivery, respectively [24].
label: none

sentence: Our modeled mean increment in maternal 25(OH)D of 102 nmol/L corresponded to a rise of 0.82 nmol/L/mcg/day (95% CI, 0.72 to 0.91), which was similar to the value often cited for non-pregnant adults (~0.7 nmol/L/mcg/day [25,26]) but smaller than the effect observed with lower vitamin D3 doses (e.g., 1.6 nmol/L/mcg/day for doses of ~800 IU/day [27]).
label: none

sentence: This is consistent with the hypothesized constraint in hepatic vitamin D–to–25(OH)D conversion that occurs at a 25(OH)D concentration of about 80–90 nmol/L [28].
label: none

sentence: In a preceding pilot trial in Dhaka, we found that 3rd-trimester regimens of 14,000 IU/week (≈2000 IU/day) and 35,000 IU/week (≈5000 IU/day) led to mean 25(OH)D concentrations of 76 nmol/L (rise of 36 nmol/L) and 98 nmol/L (rise of 57 nmol/L), respectively, after 10 weeks of supplementation [16].
label: none

sentence: Thus, compared to the present study, the average response to 35,000 IU/week was less pronounced in the pilot study.
label: none

sentence: However, direct between-study comparisons are tempered by differences in study design (e.g., shorter period of follow-up in the pilot study) and 25(OH)D assays.
label: none

sentence: In comparison to the LC-MS/MS method used here, the immunoassay used in the pilot study (Diasorin Liaison Total) may have under-estimated 25(OH)D because of raised DBP concentrations in pregnancy [29] or relative imprecision at the higher 25(OH)D range attained in the vitamin D group [30,31].
label: none

sentence: Similar to previous trials [13,16], we observed substantial inter-individual variability in the maternal Δ25(OH)D, such that the SD on the mean 25(OH)D nearly doubled from 18.4 nmol/L at baseline to 30.7 nmol/L at delivery in the vitamin D group; in contrast, in the placebo group, the SD at baseline was 20.1 nmol/L and at delivery was 18.1 nmol/L.
label: none

sentence: However, we could not identify any participant factor other than intervention group that significantly explained Δ25(OH)D. The range of published mean cord blood 25(OH)D concentrations in South Asia, from 21 [32] to 59 [33] nmol/L, bounds the mean cord 25(OH)D of 39 nmol/L in the control group.
label: none

sentence: A normal cord 25(OH)D range based on functional outcomes has not been defined; however, Zeghoud et al.
label: none

sentence: (1997) reported that newborn 25(OH)D > 30 nmol/L was associated with suppression of PTH concentrations [34], and 25(OH)D > 50 nmol/L (the 25(OH)D threshold for sufficiency set by the IOM) has been associated with a low risk of rickets [35].
label: none

sentence: In our study, 95% of newborns had a cord-maternal 25(OH)D ratio of 0.5 to 1.5, suggesting that universal maternal prenatal 25(OH)D > 100 nmol/L would ensure that nearly all cord concentrations are above 50 nmol/L.
label: none

sentence: We remain guarded in our interpretation of these pharmacokinetic data because the clinical implications of the observed changes in maternal-fetal 25(OH)D and resultant maternal PTH suppression in pregnancy remain to be defined.
label: none

sentence: Hollis et al.
label: none

sentence: concluded from their trial findings “that the current vitamin D EAR and RDA for pregnant women issued in 2010 by the IOM should be raised to 4000 IU of vitamin D per day” [13].
label: none

sentence: However, we do not believe that above-RDA doses should yet be recommended as routine practice.
label: none

sentence: Further clinical data are required before conclusive statements can be made regarding the appropriateness of high-dose antenatal vitamin D supplementation.
label: none

sentence: However, like Hollis et al., we did not encounter any evidence of vitamin D toxicity.
label: none

sentence: Vitamin D did not affect average urinary calcium excretion, yet we did see a small but significant increase in the mean adj-Ca in the vitamin D group compared to the placebo group.
label: none

sentence: Several factors suggested this was not likely to be evidence of harm.
label: none

sentence: First, this trend was attenuated and non-significant when the analysis involved uncorrected serum calcium, a less conservative endpoint used in previous trials.
label: none

sentence: Second, we did not observe a linear escalation in adj-Ca over the entire duration of supplementation, but rather found an initial increase in the rate of the natural rise in adj-Ca that occurs in late pregnancy [36] followed by an attenuation of the between-group difference after about 2 months of supplementation.
label: none

sentence: This suggested a homeostatic adjustment to the altered vitamin D status, with no further increase in serum calcium after a steady-state 25(OH)D was reached.
label: none

sentence: Third, a positive association between adj-Ca and 25(OH)D was apparent in the range of 25(OH)D below 100 nmol/L but not above 100 nmol/L; evidence of possible harm would be more consistent with the opposite finding of a serum calcium that was tightly controlled (i.e., unassociated with 25(OH)D) within the lower range of 25(OH)D, but deflected upward at higher 25(OH)D. All maternal uncorrected and adj-Ca values were below the threshold for hypercalcemia used by the IOM in the 1997 vitamin D DRIs (2.75 mmol/L) [10] and the 2010 revision (2.63 mmol/L) [7].
label: none

sentence: We set a conservative upper limit of reference range for trial monitoring (2.60 mmol/L), which was crossed by one participant in the vitamin D group; however, this was not logically attributable to vitamin D toxicity based on normal repeat serum calcium, normal ca:cr, and a 25(OH)D that was well within the range considered to be non-hypercalcemic [37].
label: none

sentence: Based on biochemical findings, and the lack of apparent clinical adverse effects, we cautiously conclude that 35,000 IU/week for an average of 10 weeks (up to 18 weeks) was tolerated by study participants, and could be considered an upper dose limit for use in future research.
label: none

sentence: This RCT had several limitations.
label: none

sentence: It was not designed to draw precise inferences regarding pregnancy/birth outcomes, which limits its clinical applications.
label: limitation

sentence: The biochemical dose–response curve would have been improved by the inclusion of other dose levels.
label: limitation

sentence: Because of the high dose of vitamin D not previously studied in pregnancy, enrolment was limited to healthy women at low risk of pregnancy complications, and who were most likely to adhere to the protocol; as such, generalizability of the findings may be limited.
label: limitation

sentence: In addition, enrolment was not conducted throughout the entire season, but rather occurred during a period in which vitamin D status was declining from its summer peak.
label: limitation

sentence: Mechanistic inferences were limited because we did not measure serum concentrations of 1,25(OH)2D, vitamin D3, or DBP.
label: limitation

sentence: As well, we did not calculate total intake of vitamin D due to the lack of adequate information regarding vitamin D content in the Bangladeshi food supply.
label: limitation

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: In conclusion, this RCT in Dhaka enabled a detailed characterization of the biochemical response to 35,000 IU/week vitamin D3 supplementation in the third-trimester of pregnancy.
label: none

sentence: Future studies involving equal or lesser doses are required to establish maternal-infant benefits and longer-term safety.
label: none
