sentence: There was no significant difference in the mean change, from baseline to 12 months, in tyrosine kinase activity (activity/μg protein) between isoflavone and placebo groups (mean ± SD): 1.62 ± 2.18 for women in the isoflavone group and 0.90 ± SD 2.72 for women in the placebo group (P = 0.16).
label: none

sentence: Hot flushes and menopausal symptoms
label: none

sentence: Interactions between treatment group and menopausal status for changes in menopausal symptom score and number of hot flushes were not statistically significant (P > 0.05).
label: none

sentence: Among women who experienced hot flushes at either assessment period, or among women whose menopausal symptom score was greater than zero at either assessment period, there were no significant effects of treatment group on hot flushes or menopausal symptoms (Table 3).
label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: Combined HRT is associated with an increased risk for breast cancer [42,43] and an increase in mammographic breast density [13,16,44].
label: none

sentence: Soy and phyto-oestrogens have been proposed as potential natural alternatives to HRT [45,46], but there are only limited data from small studies on the effect of isoflavones on breast density.
label: none

sentence: In the largest and longest study conducted thus far, we did not observe a significant effect of the clover-derived isoflavone supplement, taken daily for 1 year, on mammographic breast density.
label: none

sentence: This is in agreement with a small, exploratory study conducted in 30 premenopausal women [27], in which there were no significant effects of a soy isoflavone supplement, providing 100 mg/day isoflavones for 12 months, on mammographic breast density.
label: none

sentence: In that study, there was a slight increase in percentage density among women taking the isoflavone supplement, but differences between the intervention and placebo groups were not statistically significant.
label: none

sentence: In the present study, breast density decreased to a similar extent in both treatment groups.
label: none

sentence: This was presumably due to natural changes over time because an inverse relationship between breast density and age exists (for review [11]).
label: none

sentence: The decrease in percentage density was of a similar magnitude to that seen among control individuals in other studies [20,47] but was not as great as the decreases seen with anti-oestrogens such as tamoxifen [20].
label: none

sentence: An attractive hypothesis for the potential chemopreventive actions of isoflavones is via modulation of endocrine function.
label: none

sentence: However, the literature is conflicting with regard to the effects of soy intakes on circulating levels of oestradiol in both premenopausal and postmenopausal women; some studies have reported decreases, increases, or little effect [9,48-53].
label: none

sentence: In a recent study of premenopausal women [54], consumption of soymilk from which the isoflavones had been removed resulted in a decrease in oestradiol, suggesting that soy protein rather than soy isoflavones may be responsible for the reduction in circulating levels of oestradiol seen in some studies.
label: none

sentence: Reported effects of soy intakes on gonadotrophins have also been inconsistent, with limited data showing either no effect [49,51,55] or decreases in FSH and LH with soy supplementation [53].
label: none

sentence: Despite the fact that this was one of the longest and largest studies to have investigated the effects of an isoflavone supplement on the hormonal status of postmenopausal women, we did not observe a significant effect of the isoflavone supplement on circulating levels of oestradiol, FSH or LH.
label: none

sentence: Phyto-oestrogens have been postulated to have several other anticancer effects and, because of the possible role of genistein as an inhibitor of protein tyrosine kinase activity [56], we investigated levels of lymphocyte tyrosine kinase activity.
label: none

sentence: However, we were unable to show significant differences between treatment groups for the change in the levels of lymphocyte tyrosine kinase activity.
label: none

sentence: Soy and phyto-oestrogens have received considerable attention because of their potential role in relieving menopausal symptoms, but their efficacy in such a role remains to be fully established.
label: none

sentence: Short-term intervention studies among women experiencing frequent hot flushes have shown reductions in the frequency and/or severity of hot flushes with soy consumption, but also among control individuals [57-59], whereas others have shown little or no effect [60-63].
label: none

sentence: However, in a recent study of women experiencing more than five hot flushes per day, all study participants were given a placebo tablet in a single-blind, 4-week run-in phase, and during the subsequent 12-week double-blind phase the frequency of hot flushes was reduced by 44% in the women taking two Promensil tablets per day; no further reduction occurred in the placebo group [64].
label: none

sentence: In our study, the occurrence of hot flushes and the severity of menopausal symptoms decreased to a similar extent in both treatment groups, suggesting natural improvement over time.
label: none

sentence: It is possible that the lack of a significant treatment effect may, in part, have been due to our study population; women were not selected for the study on the basis of suffering from severe or frequent hot flushes and/or other menopausal symptoms.
label: limitation

sentence: As a result, baseline levels of menopausal symptoms were relatively low, which presumably limited the room for improvement in the study.
label: none

sentence: Polymorphisms in genes involved in sex hormone metabolism and in genes that encode hormone receptors may have an effect on the production of and exposure to sex hormones, and on the subsequent activation of genes that are responsive to sex hormones.
label: none

sentence: We investigated interactions between treatment and selected polymorphisms in the CYP17 and CYP19 genes, both of which are involved in the sex hormone biosynthesis pathway, and the oestrogen receptor (ESR1) gene.
label: none

sentence: Polymorphisms in these genes have been associated with risk for breast cancer in some but not all studies [65,66].
label: none

sentence: We saw interesting potential gene–treatment effects for the changes in breast density and ESR1 polymorphism and FSH and CYP19 polymorphism, but the study was not powered to investigate these interactions and a larger study is needed to confirm these findings.
label: limitation

sentence: Using the PABA check method as an independent marker of compliance, and urinary excretion of isoflavones, compliance with study procedures appeared to be excellent.
label: none

sentence: However, a potential limitation of this study is that, although the study size was based on a case–control study of tamoxifen and breast density [19], changes in breast density among control individuals in this study were greater than anticipated.
label: limitation

sentence: In addition, our findings may not be generalizable to the population as a whole.
label: limitation

sentence: We did not include women in this study who were taking HRT at the time of recruitment (approximately one-third of women in the UK between the ages of 50 and 64 years use HRT [67]), and we only selected women with Wolfe P2 or DY breast patterns (which comprised approximately 60% of all mammograms classified for recruitment purposes).
label: limitation

sentence: A further limitation of the study is that several statistical tests were carried out, and some of the statistically significant findings may have been due to chance.
label: limitation

sentence: Conclusion
label: none

sentence: We found that a dietary supplement that provided 26 mg biochanin A, 16 mg formononetin, 1 mg genistein and 0.5 mg daidzein daily for 1 year did not increase mammographic breast density in women aged 49–65 years, unlike conventional oestrogen replacement therapies.
label: none

sentence: Furthermore, there were no effects of the isoflavone supplement on oestradiol, FSH or LH in postmenopausal women, or on hot flushes or other menopausal symptoms.
label: none

sentence: Taken together, our findings suggest that the isoflavone supplement at the dose given was not acting as an oestrogen or as an anti-oestrogen.
label: none

sentence: Compliance of mothers following recommendations to breastfeed or withhold breast milk during rotavirus vaccination in North India: a randomized clinical trial
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Neutralizing antibodies in breast milk may adversely influence the immune response to live oral vaccines.
label: none

sentence: Withholding breastfeeding around the time of vaccine administration has been suggested for improving vaccine performance.
label: none

sentence: However, we do not know whether mothers find withholding breastfeeding around the time of vaccination acceptable and how they perceive this recommendation.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: In a clinical study designed to examine predictors of poor immune response to rotavirus vaccine in infants in India, Rotarix® was administered to infants at 6 and 10 weeks with other childhood vaccines.
label: none

sentence: For the study, 400 mother–infant pairs were randomized into two groups in a 1:1 ratio.
label: none

sentence: Mothers were either recommended to withhold breastfeeding or were encouraged to breastfeed half an hour before and after administration of Rotarix®.
label: none

sentence: The mother–infant pairs were observed and the breastfeeding intervals were recorded during this period.
label: none

sentence: Mothers were administered a questionnaire about their perception of the intervention after the infants received the second dose of Rotarix®.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: Almost 98% (391/400) of the infants received both doses of Rotarix®.
label: none

sentence: Adherence to the recommendations was high in both groups.
label: none

sentence: All mothers in the group who were asked to withhold breastfeeding did so, except one who breastfed her infant before the recommended time after the first dose of Rotarix®.
label: none

sentence: Of the mothers, 4% (7/195) reported that the recommendation to withhold breastfeeding was difficult to follow.
label: none

sentence: All mothers in this group reported that they would withhold breastfeeding at the time of vaccination if they were asked to by a health-care provider.
label: none

sentence: Only one mother responded that withholding breastfeeding would be a reason for not giving rotavirus vaccine to her infant.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: Withholding breastfeeding half an hour before and after vaccination appears to be acceptable to mothers in this setting.
label: none

sentence: If withholding breastfeeding produces an improvement in the performance of the vaccine, it could be used to increase the public health impact of rotavirus immunization.
label: none

sentence: Trial registration
label: none

sentence: Clinical Trial Registry, India (CTRI/2012/10/003057), Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT01700127).
label: none

sentence: Date of Registration: Clinical Trial Registry, India: 28 September 2012, Clinicaltrials.gov: 3 October 2012.
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Rotavirus is the most common cause of severe dehydrating diarrhea worldwide in infants and young children, killing approximately 453,000 children under the age of 5 each year [1].
label: none

sentence: Rotavirus is particularly threatening in India, causing around 100,000 deaths in young children every year [2].
label: none

sentence: Vaccination remains a cornerstone in the prevention of rotavirus-associated morbidity and mortality.
label: none

sentence: The two oral rotavirus vaccines commercially available, Rotarix® (GlaxoSmithKline Biologicals, Rixensart, Belgium) and RotaTeq (Merck and Co, PA, USA), have been shown to be safe and effective [3].
label: none

sentence: Overall, rotavirus vaccines are associated with 74% and 61% reductions in very severe and severe rotavirus infections, respectively, and a 47% reduction in rotavirus-related hospital admissions [4-8].
label: none

sentence: However, in low-income countries, these vaccines have a lower efficacy compared to other oral vaccines like polio and cholera [9].
label: none

sentence: In impoverished high-mortality settings, host factors, including maternal antibodies, interfering bacterial and viral agents, and child and maternal malnutrition, may affect immune responses [10].
label: none

sentence: In vitro studies of the neutralizing effect of breast milk have suggested that withholding breastfeeding around the time of rotavirus vaccine administration may impact vaccine performance [11].
label: none

sentence: Efficacy trials have reported no difference between breastfed and non-breastfed infants.
label: none

sentence: However, in these studies the breastfeeding practices were self-reported and the interval between breastfeeding and vaccine administration was not adequately evaluated [10,12,13].
label: none

sentence: Breast milk from Indian mothers is reported to have much higher concentrations of rotavirus-neutralizing antibodies than breast milk from mothers in industrialized countries [11].
label: none

sentence: In phase I/II studies of a recently developed rotavirus vaccine (116E) in India, breast milk was withheld for half an hour before and after each vaccine dose, and the seroconversion rate was almost 90% [14].
label: none

sentence: Other studies are also being conducted to assess the modifying effect of breast milk on vaccine efficacy [15,16].
label: none

sentence: If these studies demonstrate an improvement in the immune response by withholding breastfeeding around the time of vaccination, this practice could be used to increase the public health impact of rotavirus vaccination.
label: none

sentence: However, little is known about mothers’ perceptions of withholding breastfeeding and whether such an intervention would be feasible and acceptable to mothers in low-income settings.
label: none

sentence: The primary aim of the study was to assess the impact of withholding breastfeeding compared to encouraging breastfeeding on the immune response to Rotarix® in infants.
label: none

sentence: The results of the primary aim are not presented here.
label: none

sentence: This paper describes the study methodology and the mothers’ ability to adhere to the breastfeeding recommendation as well as their perception of the recommendation.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: Study setting
label: none

sentence: The trial was conducted in the urban resettlement neighborhoods of Govindpuri-Tigri-Dakshipuri, Tuglakabad and Sangam Vihar in South Delhi, India.
label: none

sentence: These areas are typical urban resettlement neighborhoods.
label: none

sentence: Randomization
label: none

sentence: The randomization list was generated by a statistician independent of the study team.
label: none

sentence: Subject ID allocation for each participant was through serially numbered, opaque sealed envelopes.
label: none

sentence: Sample size
label: none

sentence: The sample size was based on the primary aim of the study.
label: none

sentence: Assuming 60% seroconversion in the infants whose mothers were encouraged to breastfed and 80% in the group in whom breastfeeding was withheld, at 90% power and alpha level of 5%, 200 infants were required in each group.
label: none

sentence: This sample also accounted for 30% dropouts and 10% who might be excluded from the analysis because of high levels of antibodies at baseline.
label: none

sentence: Enrollment and intervention delivery
label: none

sentence: Participants were enrolled into the study from October 2012.
label: none

sentence: Infants aged less than 7 weeks were identified through a household survey.
label: none

sentence: The families of infants aged 6 to 7 weeks were called to the study clinic for screening and enrollment.
label: none

sentence: Infants were enrolled if their parents gave consent for participation, were aged 6 to 7 weeks, had a weight-for-age Z score that was not ≤ −3 [17] and were from a family with no plans to move out of the study area in the next 4 months.
label: none

sentence: Infants were excluded if they were not breastfed, had already received a rotavirus vaccination, had a chronic enteric disease and illness requiring hospital referral or causing diarrhea on the day of enrollment or had a condition that the investigator judged to warrant exclusion, or if the mother or infant had an immune deficiency disease.
label: none

sentence: During consent, families were informed that if they agreed to take part in the study, their baby would be randomly selected for either the withhold breastfeeding or encourage breastfeeding group.
label: none

sentence: All information was provided in the local dialect.
label: none

sentence: The verbatim information in the informed consent form regarding allocation to either group was:
label: none

sentence: You are being asked permission for your baby to be screened for this study.
label: none

sentence: This is to check if your baby is healthy enough to receive the rotavirus vaccine and the childhood vaccines.
label: none

sentence: If your baby is assessed to be well enough to receive the vaccine, your baby can take part in this study.
label: none

sentence: In case you agree to allow your baby to participate, your baby will be randomly (like tossing a coin) selected to either receive breastfeed or not be breastfed 30 minutes before and after receiving the Rotarix®.
label: none

sentence: It was also explained that the purpose of the study was to test: “The effect of not giving and giving breast milk on the antibody response of the two doses of Rotarix®”.
label: none

sentence: The rationale for asking mothers to withhold or encourage breastfeeding was: “Your baby’s participation in this study may help in generating information about the usefulness of giving or not giving breast milk before and after the Rotarix® vaccine”.
label: none

sentence: After obtaining written informed consent, 400 eligible mother–infant pairs were enrolled and randomized into one of the two study groups.
label: none

sentence: Group 1: Mothers were advised to withhold breastfeeding 30 min before and 30 min after each dose of the vaccine.
label: none

sentence: Group 2: Mothers were encouraged to breastfeed immediately before and after each dose of the vaccine.
label: none

sentence: The recommendation was given by a trained study team nutritionist in both groups.
label: none

sentence: The Group 1 mothers were told: “You have been selected to be in the group where breastfeeding needs to be withheld.
label: none

sentence: Do not breastfeed your child for half an hour before and after receiving the rotavirus vaccine”.
label: none

sentence: Group 2 mothers were told: “You have been selected to be in the group where you are encouraged to breastfeed your child in the half an hour duration before and after receiving the rotavirus vaccine”.
label: none

sentence: At the study clinic there were two separate designated areas for the two groups.
label: none

sentence: Each area was supervised by clinical coordinators.
label: none

sentence: Mother–infant pairs were required to wait in the designated area as per their group allocation.
label: none

sentence: All activities, including specimen collection and administration of vaccines, were conducted in these areas.
label: none

sentence: The team members were present in the same area to observe the mother–infant pairs during this time.
label: none

sentence: After the 30 min of observation following Rotarix® administration, the infants were administered the other childhood vaccines.
label: none

sentence: In line with usual practice, infants remained in the study clinic for another 30 min after administration of the childhood vaccines to allow observation, management and documentation of any immediate adverse events.
label: none

sentence: In this observation period, the women were not given any specific breastfeeding instructions, although breastfeeding practices were recorded by the project team members.
label: none

sentence: Each enrolled infant was given two doses of the Rotarix® vaccine along with a pentavalent vaccine (diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus, hepatitis B and Haemophilus influenzae) and an oral polio vaccine.

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: Of the 533 infants screened for eligibility, 400 were enrolled and randomized (Figure 1).
label: none

sentence: Baseline infant characteristics and socio-economic factors were comparable between the two groups (Table 1).
label: none

sentence: Nine subjects did not receive the second dose of Rotarix®; five refused further participation and four moved out of the study area, leaving 391 subjects who received both doses of Rotarix® and whose mothers completed the questionnaire on their perception of the intervention.
label: none

sentence: The number of years in school varied greatly among both mothers and fathers, from 0 to 17 and 0 to 19, respectively.
label: none

sentence: These distributions were similar in the two study groups.
label: none

sentence: Mothers in the group withholding breastfeeding had a mean of 7.2 (SD, 4.8) years of education and those in the group encouraged to breastfeed had a mean of 7.0 (SD, 4.9) years.
label: none

sentence: Similar figures were obtained for men (8.9 (SD, 4.1) and 9.1 (SD, 4.4) years, respectively).
label: none

sentence: With the exception of one mother, all mothers who were advised to withhold breastfeeding adhered fully to this recommendation (Table 2).
label: none

sentence: Similarly, all mothers who were encouraged to breastfeed, except one, breastfed at least once (range one to four times) in each of the periods before and after vaccine administration.
label: none

sentence: One woman did not breastfeed following the second dose of Rotarix®, but breastfed in the period before vaccine administration.
label: none

sentence: The interval between the last breastfeed and the beginning of the intervention period varied widely among subjects, with maximum times of 491 and 388 min and minimum times of 6 and 9 min for the first and second doses, respectively.
label: none

sentence: Mean intervals were significantly longer for infants who were given supplementary nutrition compared with those who were breastfed exclusively (mean difference, 40 min; P = 0.002).
label: none

sentence: Almost 78% of the infants were not given any other foods and fluids except breast milk; the mean number of breastfeeds per day was ten times.
label: none

sentence: It was found that 75% of the infants in the group withholding breastfeeding were being exclusively breastfed.
label: none

sentence: Infants were not breastfed for about an average of 49 and 46 min after receiving the first and second doses of Rotarix®, respectively.
label: none

sentence: Adherence to the breastfeeding recommendations was high in both groups.
label: none

sentence: Half of the mothers in each group made additional comments on how they perceived the intervention.
label: none

sentence: The main emerging theme in both groups was that the mothers found withholding breastfeeding around the time of vaccination acceptable and feasible, understanding that the vaccines were important and beneficial for their child and by withholding breastfeeding they could potentially improve the vaccine effect (Table 3).
label: none

sentence: Among mothers who were asked to withhold breastfeeding for 30 min before and after vaccine administration, seven (4%) reported that this practice was difficult; five found withholding breastfeeding stressful when their infants cried, one found the interval to be too long and one made no comment.
label: none

sentence: Three of these seven infants were breastfed exclusively.
label: none

sentence: Only one mother reported that withholding breastfeeding would be a reason for not giving the rotavirus vaccine to her infant, commenting that the duration of the non-breastfeeding period was too long.
label: none

sentence: All mothers withholding breastfeeding reported that they would adhere to this practice if asked to do so by health-care professionals.
label: none

sentence: Thirteen of them said that they would do so since they understood the importance of vaccination.
label: none

sentence: Two mothers said that they did the same when the health workers in the immunization center asked them to do so during oral polio vaccine administration.
label: none

sentence: Of the mothers who did not find withholding breastfeeding difficult, nine commented that their baby was calm and slept during the observation period, eight commented that the observation period was not too long and five reiterated that they did not find it difficult to withhold breastfeeding.
label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: This study assessed the feasibility of asking mothers to withhold breastfeeding.
label: none

sentence: Mothers did not have any difficulty in complying with this request.
label: none

sentence: The fact that almost all mothers adhered to the recommendations is encouraging and this practice can potentially be adopted into policy.
label: none

sentence: It was also observed that the recommendation appeared to be acceptable to mothers as they perceived it to be beneficial for their children.
label: none

sentence: The time of 30 min was chosen since this was assumed to be a reasonable time limit for withholding breastfeeding.
label: none

sentence: Studies show that the half gastric emptying time varies between 47 and 61 min [18-20].
label: none

sentence: Withholding breastfeeding for an hour before and after may not have been feasible in this setting.
label: limitation

sentence: Many infants would likely have been offered supplementary food or water and the intervention could inadvertently have interfered with the World Health Organization’s recommendation of exclusive breastfeeding for the first 6 months of life.
label: limitation

sentence: The 30 min time interval was used in the rotavirus vaccine 116E trials in Delhi [14], which demonstrated good immunogenicity for the vaccine.
label: none

sentence: At least two other studies are underway to assess the importance of withholding breast milk to improve the immunogenicity of oral vaccines [15,16].
label: none

sentence: Advising mothers to withhold breast milk around the time of vaccination may be contemplated if there is clear benefit.
label: none

sentence: It is essential that children get the maximum effect from their life-saving vaccines and at the same time it is essential to ensure that the benefits of breastfeeding are not undermined.
label: none

sentence: Clear messages should be developed and tested further before being used in a program setting.
label: none

sentence: It is important that the mothers understand that withholding breastfeeding around the time of vaccination may be required not because there are harmful substances in breast milk but because the beneficial substances may work against the effect of the vaccine.
label: none

sentence: This study was conducted with a limited population and the investigators did not measure the mothers’ understanding of the breastfeeding recommendations.
label: limitation

sentence: It is likely that the high compliance seen in this study is an artifact of the study setting for several reasons.
label: none

sentence: Firstly, the recommendations were given by trained study team members with a background in nutrition and skilled in delivering the message.
label: none

sentence: In this setting, it is well known that mothers are more likely to listen to health workers whom they perceive to be of a higher position and qualification: advice given by physicians or nutritionists is more likely to be adhered to.

sentence: Efficacy and safety of olokizumab in patients with rheumatoid arthritis with an inadequate response to TNF inhibitor therapy: outcomes of a randomised Phase IIb study
label: none

sentence: Objectives
label: none

sentence: The aim of this 12-week Phase IIb study was to assess the efficacy and safety of olokizumab (OKZ), a humanised anti-IL6 monoclonal antibody, in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) with moderate-to-severe disease activity who had previously failed tumour necrosis factor (TNF) inhibitor therapy.
label: none

sentence: The dose-exposure-response relationship for OKZ was also investigated.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: Patients were randomised to one of nine treatment arms receiving placebo (PBO) or OKZ (60, 120 or 240 mg) every 4 weeks (Q4W) or every 2 weeks (Q2W), or 8 mg/kg tocilizumab (TCZ) Q4W.
label: none

sentence: The primary endpoint was change from baseline in DAS28(C-reactive protein, CRP) at Week 12.
label: none

sentence: Secondary efficacy endpoints were American College of Rheumatology 20 (ACR20), ACR50 and ACR70 response rates at Week 12.
label: none

sentence: Exploratory analyses included comparisons of OKZ efficacy with TCZ.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: Across 221 randomised patients, OKZ treatment produced significantly greater reductions in DAS28(CRP) from baseline levels at Week 12, compared to PBO (p<0.001), at all the OKZ doses tested (60 mg OKZ p=0.0001, 120 and 240 mg OKZ p<0.0001).
label: none

sentence: Additionally, ACR20 and ACR50 responses were numerically higher for OKZ than PBO (ACR20: PBO=17.1–29.9%, OKZ=32.5–60.7%; ACR50: PBO=1.3–4.9%, OKZ=11.5–33.2%).
label: none

sentence: OKZ treatment, at several doses, demonstrated similar efficacy to TCZ across multiple endpoints.
label: none

sentence: Most adverse events were mild or moderate and comparable between OKZ and TCZ treatment groups.
label: none

sentence: Pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic modelling demonstrated a shallow dose/exposure response relationship in terms of percentage of patients with DAS28(CRP) <2.6.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: OKZ produced significantly greater reductions in DAS28(CRP) from baseline at Week 12 compared with PBO.
label: none

sentence: Reported AEs were consistent with the safety profile expected of this class of drug, with no new safety signals identified.
label: none

sentence: Introduction
label: none

sentence: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic, systemic autoimmune disease which can lead to destruction and physical dysfunction of joints resulting in a significant increase in morbidity and mortality.
label: none

sentence: For patients who have an inadequate response to DMARDs, tumour necrosis factor (TNF) inhibitors are frequently added, usually in combination with methotrexate (MTX).
label: none

sentence: Approximately 40–50% of patients receiving TNF inhibitors, however, also have an inadequate response to this treatment.
label: none

sentence: Therapeutic approaches using alternative mechanisms of action are therefore an important unmet need for this patient population.
label: none

sentence: An alternate therapeutic target is the pro-inflammatory cytokine interleukin-6 (IL-6).
label: none

sentence: IL-6 is an important mediator of inflammation and is involved in key immunologic processes underlying the pathology of RA, such as T-cell activation and B-cell proliferation, as well as osteoclast differentiation.
label: none

sentence: The amount of IL-6 present in the synovial fluid of patients with RA has been shown to correlate with the severity of synovitis and joint destruction.
label: none

sentence: An anti-IL-6 receptor (IL-6R) antibody, tocilizumab (TCZ), has been approved for the treatment of RA.
label: none

sentence: TCZ is a humanised monoclonal antibody that binds to the IL-6 receptor.
label: none

sentence: Olokizumab (OKZ, CDP6038), a humanised monoclonal antibody specific for the IL-6 cytokine, is currently in development for the treatment of RA.
label: none

sentence: It targets the IL-6 cytokine rather than the receptor, and selectively blocks the final assembly of the signalling complex.
label: none

sentence: In Phase I (healthy volunteers) and IIa (patients with RA on MTX) clinical trials, OKZ was well tolerated after intravenous and subcutaneous delivery with a median plasma half-life of approximately 31 days, 76% bioavailability and no apparent antidrug antibody-mediated clearance.
label: none

sentence: OKZ also markedly reduced free IL-6 levels and suppressed C-reactive protein (CRP) up to 12 weeks after single-dose subcutaneous administration in patients with RA.
label: none

sentence: The primary aims of this Phase IIb, dose-ranging study were to evaluate the efficacy and safety of OKZ in an active RA population who had previously failed TNF inhibitor therapy.
label: none

sentence: Materials and methods
label: none

sentence: Study design
label: none

sentence: This was a 12-week, Phase IIb, dose-ranging, double-blind, placebo (PBO) and active-controlled, multicenter, randomised study (NCT01242488), conducted between November 2010 and June 2012, to evaluate the efficacy and safety of subcutaneous OKZ in patients with moderately to severely active RA who had previously failed TNF inhibitor therapy.
label: none

sentence: The study protocol was approved by the Institutional Review Board/Independent Ethics Committee as defined in local regulations and performed according to the Declaration of Helsinki.
label: none

sentence: All patients provided written consent.
label: none

sentence: The primary objective of the study was to evaluate the efficacy of OKZ at different doses and administration frequencies compared with PBO.
label: none

sentence: Secondary objectives were to evaluate the safety, pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD) and immunogenicity of repeated doses of OKZ, and to assess the dose-response and exposure-response relationship of OKZ with efficacy.
label: none

sentence: An exploratory endpoint was to compare the efficacy and safety of OKZ with TCZ.
label: none

sentence: Of the 398 patients enrolled in the study, 221 were randomised to 1 of 9 treatment arms (figure 1).
label: none

sentence: Randomisation was performed centrally using an interactive voice-response system.
label: none

sentence: Patients received either PBO or OKZ (60, 120 or 240 mg) every 4 weeks (Q4W) or every 2 weeks (Q2W), or 8 mg/kg TCZ Q4W.
label: none

sentence: Doses were selected in order to cover 35–75% of the maximal anticipated effect on DAS28(erythrocyte sedimentation rate, ESR) at 12 weeks, or 45–85% of the maximal anticipated effect at 24 weeks, based on PK/PD analysis of previous study data.
label: none

sentence: Patient disposition.
label: none

sentence: Randomisation was stratified according to the number of prior failed TNF inhibitors (1 vs 2 or more).
label: none

sentence: Two safety follow-up visits were undertaken 6 and 12 weeks after the last study dose.
label: none

sentence: To maintain blinding of the treatment, all patients received an intravenous infusion Q4W and two 1.2 mL subcutaneous injections Q2W.
label: none

sentence: TCZ dose is the approved dose in Europe by the EMA, and the highest dose approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
label: none

sentence: Patients who completed the study were eligible to receive OKZ in an open-label extension study (NCT01296711).
label: none

sentence: Patients
label: none

sentence: This study population were individuals with active RA and an inadequate response to MTX, and at least one previous anti-TNF therapy.
label: none

sentence: Patients were ≥18 years old, with adult-onset RA of at least 6 months duration (1987 American College of Rheumatology (ACR) classification criteria) or a score of ≥6 by the ACR/European League Against Rheumatism (EULAR) Classification and Diagnostic Criteria for RA.
label: none

sentence: Eligible patients had tender joint count ≥6 (TJC; assessment of 68 joints) and swollen joint count ≥6 (SJC; assessment of 66 joints) and CRP ≥1.2 times the upper limit of normal (ULN), or ESR >28 mm/h.
label: none

sentence: Patients were required to be on a stable dose of MTX and continued current steroids and NSAIDs.
label: none

sentence: Major exclusion criteria included diagnoses of other inflammatory arthritis or a non-inflammatory type of arthritis that interfered with efficacy evaluations, functional capacity Steinbrocker Class IV, and prior exposure to IL-6 inhibitors.
label: none

sentence: Patients were not permitted to use DMARDs other than MTX within 12 weeks prior to screening (unless undertaking appropriate washout).
label: none

sentence: Patients with a known risk of severe or major infections, or elevated levels at screening of creatinine, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) or aspartate aminotransferase (AST), or reduced platelets, white blood cell count or neutrophil count were excluded.
label: none

sentence: Efficacy analyses
label: none

sentence: Efficacy outcomes were assessed in the Full Analysis Set (FAS), consisting of all randomised patients who received at least one dose of study medication and had at least one post-baseline efficacy measurement.
label: none

sentence: The primary efficacy endpoint was the change from baseline in DAS28(CRP) at Week 12.
label: none

sentence: Secondary efficacy endpoints were ACR20, ACR50 and ACR70 at Week 12 for OKZ and PBO.
label: none

sentence: Major exploratory analyses included: ACR20/50/70 response rates (at Weeks 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12), % of patients with DAS28(CRP) <2.6 at Weeks 2, 4, 8 and 12), TJC, SJC, Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI) and the Health Assessment Questionnaire-Disability Index (HAQ-DI).
label: none

sentence: Safety
label: none

sentence: Safety assessments included measurement of vital signs and laboratory parameters as well as recording of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) and serious TEAEs.
label: none

sentence: Safety variables were analysed using the Safety Set (SS) (all patients who received at least 1 dose, or partial dose, of study medication).
label: none

sentence: Statistical analyses
label: none

sentence: Unless specifically stated, FAS was used for all analyses.
label: none

sentence: DAS28(CRP) was analysed using a mixed effects model for repeated measures (MMRM).
label: none

sentence: ACR20/50/70 responder rates were estimated using generalised estimating equation (GEE) methodology with Multiple Imputation (MI).
label: none

sentence: Missing data for SJC/TJC/HAQ-DI/CDAI change from baseline were imputed using last observation carried forward (LOCF).
label: none

sentence: Non-responder imputation was used for analysis of % patients with DAS28(CRP) <2.6 to control for missing values.
label: none

sentence: The number of prior failed TNF inhibitors was included as a categorical covariate in all statistical analyses.
label: none

sentence: Unless otherwise stated, all statistical tests were two-sided.
label: none

sentence: Power and sample size calculations were based upon simulations for change from baseline in DAS28 at all assessed postbaseline visits, using the MMRM method specified for the primary efficacy analysis.
label: none

sentence: Pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic analyses
label: none

sentence: Blood samples for determination of plasma OKZ, TCZ and anti-OKZ antibodies were collected at baseline and at each subsequent visit.
label: none

sentence: Non-linear mixed modelling was employed for the analysis of the OKZ PK data.
label: none

sentence: The final population PK model was used to derive individual concentration or exposure measures for use in the PK/PD analyses which involved describing the relationship between PK measures and multiple efficacy and safety endpoints via mixed effects methodology.
label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: In this Phase II study of patients with RA who had previously failed TNF inhibitor therapy, treatment with OKZ resulted in significantly greater reductions in DAS28(CRP) from baseline levels at Week 12 compared with treatment with PBO.
label: none

sentence: This improvement was demonstrated at all the OKZ doses tested with generally comparable efficacy and across both dosing frequencies, and was statistically significant for all dose group comparisons (60, 120 or 240 mg vs PBO).
label: none

sentence: At low OKZ doses, a posthoc analysis showed greater responses in patients who met the criterion of high CRP at study entry compared to all other patients.
label: none

sentence: The primary efficacy endpoint was further supported by the secondary efficacy variables.
label: none

sentence: Estimated ACR20 and ACR50 response rates at Week 12 were numerically higher in all OKZ treatment arms than PBO groups, although the study was not powered to show a statistical difference in the ACR response rates.
label: limitation

sentence: Few patients in any treatment group were ACR70 responders.
label: none

sentence: Comparisons of exploratory efficacy variables, including health outcomes endpoints generally suggested greater improvement in OKZ treatment groups compared with the PBO groups.
label: none

sentence: Overall, exploratory comparison showed similar responses to subcutaneous OKZ treatment and intravenously administered TCZ across multiple efficacy endpoints and for several OKZ treatment groups.
label: none

sentence: Reported TEAEs in this study were consistent with the safety profile expected of this class of drug, with no new safety signals identified.
label: none

sentence: Commonly reported TEAEs in OKZ treated patients included gastrointestinal disorders, infections and infestations (primarily upper and lower respiratory tract infections and urinary tract infections) and nervous system disorders, which is qualitatively similar to the safety profile observed for TCZ in this and other previously published trials, as well as other anti-IL6 s in development.
label: none

sentence: These TEAEs occurred at similar frequencies in the PBO, OKZ and TCZ treated groups.
label: none

sentence: There were no incidences of diverticulitis or gastrointestinal perforations reported during the study.
label: none

sentence: In accordance with the role of IL-6 in immune regulation, inflammation and haematopoiesis, reported TEAEs included increases in AST, ALT and lipids, and decreases in neutrophil levels.
label: none

sentence: As expected, small increases from baseline in median total cholesterol, LDL and triglycerides and decreases in neutrophils were observed in each of the active treatment arms, including the TCZ group, throughout the 12-week study.
label: none

sentence: Cuff pressure (P ) control is mandatory to avoid leakage of oral secretions passing the tracheal tube and tracheal ischemia.
label: none

label: none

label: none

label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Intubation is an invasive procedure that is still performed in a large proportion of critically ill patients [1].
label: none

sentence: Some long-term intubation-related complications are caused by inappropriate cuff pressure (P ), and include microaspiration, and tracheal ischemic lesions [2, 3].
label: none

sentence: Microaspiration of contaminated oropharyngeal secretions is the main route of entry for bacteria into the lower respiratory tract [4, 5].
label: none

sentence: Colonization of the lower respiratory tract could progress into ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) when local or general defense mechanisms are altered in intubated critically ill patients [6].
label: none

sentence: VAP is the most frequent infection acquired in the ICU and is associated with high morbidity and mortality, especially in patients with comorbidities [7].
label: none

sentence: Tracheal ischemic injury is also associated with high morbidity, especially when routine care for tracheal cuff is not adequately provided [8–11].
label: none

sentence: Based on international recommendations, P  should be kept between 20 and 30 cmH O using a manometer [12, 13].
label: none

sentence: However, several recent studies suggested that a noncontinuous control of P  using a manometer is not effective in intubated critically ill patients [14].
label: none

sentence: Further, previous studies did not identify modifiable risk factors for overinflation or underinflation of tracheal cuff [15–18].
label: none

sentence: Recently, several devices allowing continuous control of P  were evaluated [19–22].
label: none

sentence: These devices are classified into pneumatic (i.e., does not require power supply, but a single-use 200-ml cylindrical cuff) and electronic devices (requiring power supply).
label: none

sentence: Two prospective randomized controlled animal and human studies first validated the use of a pneumatic device [19, 20].
label: none

sentence: A noncommercially available device has also been validated and proved to be efficient in continuously controlling P  in ICU patients [22].
label: none

sentence: However, other commercially available automated devices were only validated in in vitro studies [23, 24].
label: none

sentence: Recent data suggest that these devices interfere with the self-sealing characteristics of high-volume low-pressure (HVLP) tracheal cuffs [23].
label: none

sentence: Further, these electronic devices have been shown to be less efficient than the pneumatic device in continuous control of P , because of rapid correction of overinflation episodes [21].
label: none

sentence: A new mechanical device with an improved design aiming at continuously controlling P  has been commercialized (PressureEasy®, Smiths medical).
label: none

sentence: The advantages of using such device are its small size and lower cost compared with other devices.
label: none

sentence: However, to our knowledge, no study has evaluated the efficiency of this device in controlling P .
label: none

sentence: Therefore, we conducted this prospective randomized cross-over study to determine the efficiency of this device in continuously controlling P .
label: none

sentence: Our hypothesis was that this mechanical device would allow significant reduction of time spent with underinflation or overinflation of P , compared with routine care, using a manual manometer.
label: none

sentence: Subgroup analysis
label: none

sentence: After exclusion of the four patients with high mean airway pressure (>17 cmH O), no significant difference was found in mean P  (26 (18, 28) versus 22 (19, 27) cmH O, p = 0.177), percentage of time spent with P  between 20 and 30 cmH O (50 (24, 58) versus 53 (24, 71), p = 0.124), percentage of time spent with P  <20 cmH O (16 (2, 51) versus 35 (9, 51), p = 0.3), or coefficient of variation of P  (15 (10, 22) versus 16 (10, 24), p = 0.363).

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: The results of our study suggest that PressureEasy® was not more efficient in maintaining P  within the recommended range (20–30 cmH O) than routine care of tracheal cuff using a manometer every 4 h. No significant difference was found between continuous control of P  using the mechanical device and routine care regarding P , percentage of time spent with underinflation of tracheal cuff, and coefficient of variation of P .
label: none

sentence: However, the percentage of time spent with overinflation of tracheal cuff was significantly higher during continuous control compared with routine care.
label: none

sentence: One potential explanation for this result is the high frequency of P  control using the manometer, i.e., every 4 h, during routine care.
label: none

sentence: A recent prospective study performed in a cohort of 102 patients receiving invasive mechanical ventilation and manual control of P  using a manometer every 8 h found a lower percentage of time (18 %) spent within the target range [14].
label: none

sentence: However, this explanation is unlikely because our results are in agreement with those of another recent trial, in which P  was controlled using a manometer every 8 h [13].
label: none

sentence: Further, previous studies showed that each time a manometer is connected to the tracheal cuff, a sudden drop of P  is observed [22, 26].
label: none

sentence: This is probably related to transient underinflation of tracheal cuff and might promote microaspiration of contaminated secretions [27].
label: none

sentence: Therefore, controlling P  more frequently in order to maintain it within the target range could probably not be recommended.
label: none

sentence: In spite of strictly applying instructions for user of the mechanical device, the percentage of time spent within the target range of P  was only 34 %.
label: none

sentence: Previous studies using different devices to continuously control P  reported better performances and a percentage within the targeted range >90 % [19, 20, 22, 28].
label: none

sentence: Another potential explanation for the low efficiency of the device is the mechanism of P  control.
label: none

sentence: This device uses the respiratory flow to inflate tracheal cuff during inspiration.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, it is dependent on respiratory flow and airway pressure that may widely vary in critically ill patients.
label: none

sentence: In addition, the key principle is probably an equilibrium between airway pressure and P , which means that the time constant of the system might play a role in the higher P  [29, 30].
label: none

sentence: Further, the exact P  target, using the mechanical device, could not be precisely determined or modified.
label: none

sentence: In order to test the hypothesis that our results could be explained by the bad performance of the device in patients with high airway pressures, we repeated all statistical analyses after exclusion of patients with the highest mean airway pressure but found similar results.
label: none

sentence: This might be explained by the fact that high airway pressure could have occurred during only a short period of the total recording time and the relatively small number of included patients.
label: none

sentence: To our knowledge, our study is the first to evaluate the PressureEasy® mechanical device, and its results suggest that the device should not be used in critically ill patients.
label: none

sentence: Our study also raises the important question of why medical devices such as tracheal tubes or P  controllers could obtain the Communauté Européenne (CE) mark and be used in critically ill patients without any published clinical data proving their efficiency.
label: none

sentence: Nevertheless, clinical evaluation before CE mark could be very complex and might reduce the development of new technologies.
label: none

sentence: No significant difference was found in coefficient of variation of P  between the two study periods.
label: none

sentence: However, P  variation in study patients was relatively small and had probably no clinical impact, except in those patients with P  around 20 or 30 cmH O.
label: none

sentence: Some limitations of our study should be acknowledged.
label: none

sentence: First, this was a single-center study.
label: limitation

sentence: All study patients received assist-control ventilation, and a high proportion of them were sedated.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, our results may not be generalized to patients in other ICUs, especially to nonsedated patients receiving pressure support ventilation.
label: limitation

sentence: Second, the number of studied patients was relatively small.
label: limitation

sentence: However, P  was continuously recorded for 48 h. In addition, the number of included patients was calculated based on our hypothesis before starting the study.
label: none

sentence: Third, because of the study design, namely the fact that every patient was its own control, we could not evaluate complications related to underinflation or overinflation of tracheal cuff.
label: limitation

sentence: However, we think that this design is probably optimal as a first step in order to validate the device, before performing larger studies evaluating its impact on complications.
label: none

sentence: Our study design allowed adjustment of patient-related confounding factors, such as tracheal anatomy, tracheal tube size, and airway pressure.
label: none

sentence: Fourth, we excluded patients who could not be included during the first 48 h of their invasive mechanical ventilation.
label: limitation

sentence: This exclusion criterion was selected because duration of intubation was identified as a risk factor for underinflation of tracheal cuff [14].
label: none

sentence: Fifth, we did not collect P  values obtained manually during the routine care period and did not evaluate the relationship between manometer connection and any drop in P .
label: limitation

sentence: However, several previous well-designed and performed studies have clearly confirmed this relationship [22, 26].
label: none

sentence: Finally, Glascow Coma score was used to evaluate consciousness in study patients.
label: none

sentence: However, a sedation score would have been more appropriate in sedated patients.
label: limitation

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: The PressureEasy® device did not demonstrate a better control of P  within the target range (20–30 cmH O), compared with routine care using a manometer every 4 h. Moreover, the percentage of time spent with overinflation of tracheal cuff was more frequent using this device compared with routine care, which might increase the risk for tracheal ischemic lesions.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, the use of this device could not be recommended in critically ill patients.
label: none

sentence: Further large studies are required to confirm our results.

sentence: This was associated with the discovery of the negative impact of permanent polymers of the first generation DES on the vessel wall, which resulted in impaired healing and endothelialization [3].

sentence: The idea assumed that the biodegradable polymer would be absorbed from the stent surface after drug elution, and the remaining bare metal stent platform covered with neointima would not evoke further irritation to the artery wall [4].

sentence: Procedure

sentence: Percutaneous coronary interventions (PCI) were performed according to local standards via radial or femoral access using 6 Fr or 7 Fr guiding catheters.

sentence: Pharmacological treatment was according to the most recent guidelines.

sentence: Endpoints

sentence: The primary endpoint was the cumulative rate of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) consisting of cardiac death, myocardial infarction (MI) and clinically-driven target lesion revascularization (TLR).
label: none

sentence: Secondary endpoints included cardiac death, all-cause death, MI, TLR, target vessel revascularization (TVR), stent thrombosis, late lumen loss (LLL) assessed in quantitative coronary angiography (QCA), the percentage of covered struts and neointima volume and morphology characteristics assessed in OCT, as well as the device success rate.
label: none

sentence: Cardiac death included death resulting from an acute MI, sudden cardiac death, death due to heart failure and death due to cardiac procedures.
label: none

sentence: All deaths were deemed cardiac unless proven otherwise.
label: none

sentence: MI was defined according to third universal definition [6].
label: none

sentence: Clinically-driven TLR was defined as reintervention of the target lesion due to presence of a symptomatic ≥ 50 % diameter stenosis during follow-up.
label: none

sentence: TVR was defined as any revascularization of any segment of the index coronary artery.
label: none

sentence: Device success was defined as successful deployment of the intended stent in the target site without a system failure.
label: none

sentence: The definite stent thrombosis was defined as state with symptoms suggestive of an acute coronary syndrome and angiographic or pathologic confirmation of stent thrombosis.
label: none

sentence: The probable stent thrombsis was defined as the unexplained death within 30 days or target vessel myocardial infarction without angiographic confirmation of stent thrombosis, and the possible stent thrombosis was defined as any unexplained death after 30 days [7].

label: none

sentence: All coronary angiograms were recorded after an intracoronary administration of 200 μg of nitroglycerin.
label: none

sentence: Two orthogonal views were chosen to visualize the target lesion.

sentence: A QCA analysis was performed using commercially available software (QCA-CMS version 5.0, Medis, Leiden, the Netherlands).

sentence: Catheter calibration was used in all cases.

sentence: Optical coherent tomography analysis
label: none

sentence: Time-domain OCT examinations were performed using a well validated non-occlusive technique [9].
label: none

sentence: Briefly, after wiring the artery with the guidewire as described previously, the Dragon Fly catheter (LigthLab Co.) was advanced distally to the implanted stent and during continuous contrast media flush (Iodixanol, Visipaque GE Healthcare), the automatic pullback was performed.
label: none

sentence: The commercially available console (M2 or M3 by LigthLab Co.) was used.
label: none

sentence: Optical coherence tomography images were obtained along the region of interest, which was the implanted stent plus 5 mm both proximal and distal.
label: none

sentence: Off-line analysis was performed after careful recalibration of acquired images along the reconstructed longitudinal segment.
label: none

sentence: Calibration was obtained by adjusting the z-offset, the zero-point setting of the system.
label: none

sentence: The analysis was performed applying a dedicated off-line software (St Jude Medical).
label: none

sentence: Quantitative measurements of the minimal lumen area and minimal lumen diameter were obtained in all consecutive frames along the region of interest using semi-automated algorithm.

sentence: Additionally, the mean value of all lumen area cross-sections measured inside the region was calculated.

sentence: Additionally, lumen volume analysis was performed along region of interest - all measured lumen area cross-sections were summed.
label: none

sentence: Mean neointimal burden was calculated as the ratio of the mean neointima area to the mean stent area.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, to assess stent apposition OCT analysis was performed every 0.2 mm of the stent.

sentence: The stent struts apposition was classified as: 1) apposed 2) protruded and 3) malapposed according to a distance length between vessel wall and center of the stent strut.

sentence: If such distance was: 1) more than 130 μm, malapposition was detected, 2) in range of 20 to 130 μm, protrusion was detected.

sentence: The morphology of the neointima was analyzed according to the previously validated OCT criteria, and classified as type I (thin cap neoatheroma, lipid-rich), type II (thick-cap, layered), type III (peri-strut, homogenous) and type IV (pre-existing, homogenous) [10, 11].

sentence: The analysis was performed independently by two interventional cardiologists: TP and JB.

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: This is the first study presenting clinical outcomes of Prolim® stent deployment in all-comers with de novo coronary lesions with the use OCT for the precise assessment of vascular healing.
label: none

sentence: The main findings of this study confirmed that Prolim® stent characterized the very good performance with MACE and clinically driven TLR rates at 12 months of 6.9 % and 5.4 %, respectively.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, the long-term safety was confirmed by the lack of thrombosis cases and the extremely low number of uncovered stent struts as well as by the homogenous structure of neointima in the OCT analysis.
label: none

sentence: The deployment of a durable polymer DES (DP-DES) is a standard of care in patients with coronary artery lesions.
label: none

sentence: However, studies assessing biodegradable polymer DES (BP-DES) proved the non-inferiority to DP-DES with the expectation for the decreased inflammatory response after stent implantation and, as a consequence, for faster vessel healing [12].
label: none

sentence: Moreover, sirolimus-eluting BP-DES and DP-DES showed similar results in STEMI patients [13].
label: none

sentence: The Prolim® study group consisted of patients with both stable coronary artery disease as well as acute coronary syndromes, including STEMI and NSTEMI.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, 3.9 % of stented lesions were located in saphenous grafts, 38.8 % - within bifurcation lesions and 36.7 % - in complex lesions (type B2/C).
label: none

sentence: The primary study endpoint occurred in 6.9 % of patients (n = 14), and clinically-driven TLR rate was 5.4 % (n = 11).
label: none

sentence: There was no death or in-stent thrombosis.
label: none

sentence: These results are in line with previous studies with BP-SES implantation.
label: none

sentence: In the study assessing Supralimus® stent (Sahajanand Medical Technologies, Gujarat, India) MACE rate was 0 % after one month, 6 % at 9-month follow-up and 7 % after 30 months follow-up [14].
label: none

sentence: Initial results of the prospective trial assessing Excel® stent (BP-SES) showed that at 12 months MACE and TLR rates were both 4 % [15].
label: none

sentence: Whereas in the BIOFLOW III Registry with Orsiro® (Biotronik, Berlin, Germany) stent the TLR rate was 5.1 % [16].
label: none

sentence: Worth mentioning is the BIOFLOW II trial, in which Orsiro® stent was compared with everolimus-eluting Xience® stent (MACE at 1 year SES 6.5 % versus EES 8.0 %) [17].
label: none

sentence: Moreover, in the ISAR-TEST-4 study patients presenting with stable coronary disease or acute coronary syndromes undergoing DES implantation in de novo coronary lesions were randomly assigned to treatment with BP-DES (sirolimus-eluting; n = 1299) or DP-DES (n = 1304: sirolimus-eluting, Cypher® or everolimus-eluting, Xience®).
label: none

sentence: BP-DES was non-inferior to DP-DES concerning the primary endpoint (13.8 % vs. 14.4 %, p = 0.66) and showed similar rates of cardiac death or MI related to the target vessel (6.3 % vs. 6.2 %, p = 0.94), TLR (8.8 % vs. 9.4 %, p = 0.58), and stent thrombosis (definite/probable: 1.0 % vs. 1.5 %, p = 0.29) [18].
label: none

sentence: At 12 months the late lumen loss of the Prolim® stent was 0.21 ± 0.18 mm.
label: none

sentence: Worth mentioning is ISAR-TEST3 study, in which patients with de novo coronary lesions were randomly assigned to receive a BP-DES, a polymer-free DES stent or DP-DES (Cypher®).
label: none

sentence: The mean late lumen loss at 6–8-month follow-up was 0.17 ± 0.45 mm in the BP stent group, 0.23 ± 0.46 mm in the Cypher® cohort, and 0.47 ± 0.56 mm in the polymer-free stent group [19].
label: none

sentence: In previously mentioned studies the late lumen loss values were as followed: for Excel® stent - 0.12 ± 0.34 mm, for Orsiro® stent – 0.10 ± 0.32 mm, for Xience® stent – 0.11 ± 0.29 mm, and for Supralimus® stent – 0.09 ± 0.37 mm [14, 15, 17].
label: none

sentence: Simultaneously one must underline that the Prolim® stent is a relatively thick-strut DES, which platform is made of stainless steel 316 L (115 μm).
label: none

sentence: And as earlier studies showed this might be associated with worse clinical and angiographic outcomes both in BMS as well as in DES [20–22].
label: none

sentence: However, in our study higher LLL value did not translate into worse clinical outcomes.
label: none

sentence: The safety profile of the stent is confirmed by a high rate of the device success (99 %) and a low rate of periprocedural complications.
label: none

sentence: The rate of MI type 4a of 3.4 % might have been associated with the fact that certain implantations were performed in lesions located within bifurcations or venous grafts.
label: none

sentence: Worth mentioning is the fact that despite the relative small stent cells size (for Prolim® stent of 3 mm in diameter, the maximal diameter of the expanded stent cell is 1.8 mm), the side branch occlusion was not nearly (0.98 %) observed.
label: none

sentence: The second issue associated with safety is the rate of thrombosis.
label: none

sentence: In case of Prolim® stent there was no early or late in-stent thrombosis.
label: none

sentence: Presently, stent thrombosis in second or third generation stents is a rare clinical scenario [23].
label: none

sentence: Also, as confirmed in several meta-analyses BP-DES compared with DP-DES are associated with a lower rate of very late stent thrombosis and an equivalent risk of MACE [24, 25].
label: none

sentence: This probably might be associated with the fact that over time, the drug-coated polymers of BP-DES can gradually degrade into completely harmless CO  and H O molecules that are excreted from a patient’s body.
label: none

sentence: In this manner, a BP- DES can completely transform into a BMS following a slow, controlled drug release.
label: none

sentence: Thus, comparing to DP-DES, BP-DES can reduce drug-induced delays in vascular endothelialization and inflammatory responses of local vessel walls caused by the presence of a permanent polymer, thereby achieving the dual purpose of preventing both in-stent restenosis and late stent thrombosis [26].
label: none

sentence: Safety is always the major concern in a novel DES.
label: none

sentence: Initial OCT studies reported that BP-SES characterized faster neointima coverage comparing with durable polymer SES [27].
label: none

sentence: Therefore, we performed an OCT subgroup analysis to better understand the endothelialization process over time.
label: none

sentence: We found almost complete vessel healing with 99.3 % stent strut coverage 12 months after the index procedure.
label: none

sentence: This was superior to the 96.5 % coverage rate of everolimus-eluting stent Xience V® (Abbott Vascular, Santa Clara, CA) and the 93.5 % coverage rate of the zotarolimus-eluting stent Resolute Integrity® (Medtronic Inc., Santa Rosa, CA) in the 13-month OCT substudy of the RESOLUTE All Comers trial [28].
label: none

sentence: Also, this was in line with an OCT substudy of LEADERS trial, in which BP-DES characterized a more complete stent coverage (99.4 %) as compared with DP-DES (97.9 %) at 9 months follow-up [29].
label: none

sentence: Also, the RUTTS score (Ratio of Uncovered to Total Stent Struts Per Cross Section) indicated very good healing (RUTTS ≤ 30 % = 100 %).
label: none

sentence: This is crucial since RUTTS score is a useful predictor for late stent thrombosis [30].
label: none

sentence: Moreover, no thrombi were detected under OCT inspection.
label: none

sentence: However, this excellent strut tissue coverage might have been achieved at the price of excessive neointimal growth.
label: none

sentence: In OCT analysis mean neointima volume was 28.16 ± 15.10 mm3 and mean neointima burden was 24.6 ± 8.6 %.
label: none

sentence: These findings correlated with mean neointimal area per section of 2.17 ± 1.37 mm2 that was thicker as compared with that observed in BP-DES in paper by Davlouros (0.4 mm2) or in NOBORI stent (biodegradable polymer, biolimus-eluting stent, 0.5 mm2) [31, 32].
label: none

sentence: However, recently published STACCATO trail showed in OCT a significantly higher percentage of uncovered struts in the BioMatrix BES stent compared with the XIENCE EES at nine-month follow-up.
label: none

sentence: This study presented the opposite findings and did not support a preferential use of stents with biodegradable polymer-based biolimus elution to reduce the risk for stent thrombosis [33].
label: none

sentence: Ultimately, OCT results provided the additional insight in the characteristics of neointima formation in BP-DES at 12 months after its implantation.
label: none

sentence: In most cases homogenous peristrut or preexisting atheroma (82.8 %, n = 24) was observed, and only in 4 (13.8 %) cases there was layered neoatheroslerosis, and in 1 (3.4 %) case there was a heterogenous, thin-cap neoatheroma.
label: none

sentence: These data are crucial since the homogeneous neointima pattern correlated in earlier reports with a high proportion of connective tissue and smooth muscle cells in histopathology indicating favorable vessel healing, whereas, heterogenous neointima was found to correlate with higher presence of fibrin as compared to homogenous one and was associated with poorer clinical outcomes.
label: none

sentence: Also the layered neointima corresponded with peristrut inflammation, and a small proportion of layered neointima suggested a lower inflammatory response to BP-DES as compared with DP-DES [34, 35].
label: none

sentence: However, one must remember that OCT imaging is not as good as fractional flow reserve measurements in predicting the significance of the coronary lesion [36].
label: none

sentence: Clinical results of our study have proved the safe profile of healing process after Prolim® stent implantation and indirectly have confirmed that similarly to other trials with BP-DES this particular stent does not require a prolonged dual antiplatelet therapy since it increases the risk of bleeding, and might be associated with adverse cardiac events at 1-year follow-up [37].
label: none

sentence: Study limitations
label: none

sentence: This registry has several limitations that should be acknowledged.
label: none

sentence: First of all the sample size was relatively small and no sample size calculation was performed.
label: limitation

sentence: Other limitations of this study are its non-randomized manner and all known drawbacks of registry studies.
label: limitation

sentence: The study was based mainly on clinical follow-up and control coronary angiography was performed in half of patients therefore some Prolim® stent failures might have been missed.
label: none

sentence: However, despite this it was not restricted only to symptomatic patients and in addition a representative part was supplemented with OCT analysis.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: Sirolimus-eluting Prolim® stent with a biodegradable polymer is a feasible device with a very good safety profile and long-term clinical effectiveness.
label: none

sentence: The OCT analysis showed excellent vessel healing with homogenous neointima proliferation.

sentence: Introduction
label: none

sentence: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory disease of the colon and rectum distinguished by cycles of remission and relapse over the life of the subject.1,2 While the incidence of UC peaks around early adulthood, onset of the disorder can occur from early childhood through adulthood.3 UC is one of the more prevalent chronic diseases in children, with an incidence rate of 2.1 per 100,000 children within the United States.4
label: none

sentence: The primary goals in UC management are induction and maintenance of remission to improve subjects’ health and quality of life.5 Oral 5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA) formulations, such as multimatrix mesalamine (Shire US Inc., Wayne, PA, USA), have proven effective in the induction and maintenance of UC remission,6–10 and are recommended first-line therapy for adults with active mild-to-moderate UC.5,6 5-ASAs are also commonly used as the standard of care first-line therapy in pediatric UC.
label: none

sentence: However, while studies that support 5-ASA use in adult subjects with UC are abundant,11 evidence on the efficacy and safety of 5-ASA in pediatric UC subjects is less substantial, with only a few randomized, controlled clinical studies for the induction or maintenance of remission by 5-ASA in pediatric subjects having been conducted.12,13 To date, no 5-ASA product has been licensed for maintenance of remission of UC in children.
label: none

sentence: As the first step in a program evaluating multimatrix mesalamine in pediatric UC, the primary objective of this randomized Phase I study (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT01130844) was to assess the pharmacokinetics of 5-ASA and its major metabolite acetyl-5-ASA (Ac-5-ASA) after administration of once-daily multimatrix mesalamine at three different doses (30, 60, or 100 mg/kg/day) for 7 days in children and adolescents diagnosed with UC.
label: none

sentence: Secondary objectives included examining the safety and tolerability of multimatrix mesalamine at these doses in children and adolescents with UC, and evaluating the extent of absorption of 5-ASA from multimatrix mesalamine at steady state.
label: none

sentence: This Phase I, multicenter, randomized, open-label, three-arm study was conducted in 12 sites across three countries (United States, Poland, and Slovakia).

sentence: Children and adolescents (aged 5–17 years) with a diagnosis of UC were randomly assigned to receive multimatrix mesalamine 30, 60, or 100 mg/kg once daily (up to a maximum of 4,800 mg/day) each morning for 7 days.

label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: This is the first study to evaluate the safety and pharmacokinetics of multimatrix mesalamine in children and adolescents diagnosed with UC.
label: none

sentence: Multimatrix mesalamine was generally safe and well tolerated.
label: none

sentence: No fatal TEAEs, other serious TEAEs, or TEAEs leading to discontinuation of treatment occurred during the study, and the incidence of TEAEs was comparable between dose and age groups.
label: none

sentence: Furthermore, the types and frequencies of clinical laboratory abnormalities and other safety parameters were low, and comparable between dose and age groups.
label: none

sentence: The pharmacokinetic profiles of 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA at 30 or 60 mg/kg once daily were similar to those observed historically in adults after a 2,400 mg daily dose.15,16 Likewise, the pharmacokinetic profiles of 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA at 100 mg/kg once daily were also similar to those in adults after a 4,800 mg daily dose.15,16 These conclusions were based on the variable absorption profiles with initial and secondary peaks, the percentage of the 5-ASA absorbed, renal clearance of 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA, plasma exposure (AUC  and C ), and the inter-subject variability in pharmacokinetic parameters (Table 2).15,16 For example, in adults, the total absorption of 5-ASA from multimatrix mesalamine 2.4 or 4.8 g administered once daily for 14 days to healthy volunteers was approximately 21%–22% of the administered dose.15 In the current study, 5-ASA absorption ranged from 22% to 29% across doses.
label: none

sentence: The overall similarity in 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA exposures between children/adolescents and adults suggests that the novel, smaller 300 and 600 mg multimatrix mesalamine tablets developed for this study performed as intended, delivering 5-ASA to the colon in a similar fashion to the commercial 1,200 mg multimatrix mesalamine tablets.
label: none

sentence: Hence, these new 300 and 600 mg tablets may be suitable for use in future studies.
label: none

sentence: For both 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA, pharmacokinetic steady state was attained by day 5 for all doses, and systemic exposure of 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA (measured by mean AUC  and C ) on day 7 increased in a dose-proportional manner between 30 and 60 mg/kg/day doses (Table 2).
label: none

sentence: Mean AUC  and C  increased subproportionally between 60 and 100 mg/kg/day doses, possibly due to the maximum dose restriction of 4,800 mg/day, with the highest dose of 100 mg/kg only being administered to subjects weighing less than 50 kg.
label: none

sentence: In the 100 mg/kg/day dose group, a mean of 22.1% of the dose was absorbed (similar to the 21%–22% observed in adults),15 whereas the corresponding values for the 30 and 60 mg/kg/day dose groups were higher (29.4% and 27.0%, respectively), suggesting that there also may be differences in the extent of absorption.
label: none

sentence: Nevertheless, these assessments of dose-proportionality should be interpreted with caution due to the large inter-subject pharmacokinetic variability and the small sample size (n=9) receiving 100 mg/kg/day.
label: limitation

sentence: In addition to the typical non-compartmental pharmacokinetic analysis, a population pharmacokinetic model was developed to describe the pharmacokinetics of 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA (Figure S1), and was subsequently used to simulate exposures in a broader population of children and adolescents with UC, following repeat oral administration of multimatrix mesalamine (Figures 3A–D; Tables S3 and S4).
label: none

sentence: The variability in the predicted steady-state exposures for children and adolescents was similar to the observed variability in adults for both 5-ASA AUC (CV ≈50% in children and adolescents and 60% in adults) and Ac-5-ASA AUC (CV ≈40%–45% in both populations).15,16 Additionally, absorption from two depots, as described in the final model, is consistent with the multimatrix mesalamine tablet, delivering an initial burst of 5-ASA that occurs from disintegration of the enteric coating, followed by leaching of 5-ASA out of the core as the tablet travels through the terminal ileum and colon.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, the absorption data provide support for the drug being delivered in accordance with the design concept.
label: none

sentence: Finally, results from the modeling and simulation in the current analysis suggest that the proposed dosing regimen for examining the safety and efficacy of multimatrix mesalamine in children and adolescents is likely to produce exposures to 5-ASA and Ac-5-ASA within the range of exposures at which safety and efficacy have been established in adults.
label: none

sentence: As a result, these data supported the proposed doses for the Phase III safety and efficacy trial of multimatrix mesalamine in pediatric patients with UC (PACE; NCT02093663).
