sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Recent exercise guidelines for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) recommend a minimum of 30 min moderate intensity aerobic exercise and resistance exercise twice per week.
label: none

sentence: This trial compared the secondary outcomes of a combined 10-week guideline based intervention and a Social Cognitive Theory (SCT) education programme with the same exercise intervention involving an attention control education.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: Physically inactive people with MS, scoring 0–3 on Patient Determined Disease Steps Scale, with no MS relapse or change in MS medication, were randomised to 10-week exercise plus SCT education or exercise plus attention control education conditions.
label: none

sentence: Outcomes included fatigue, depression, anxiety, strength, physical activity, SCT constructs and impact of MS and were measured by a blinded assessor pre and post-intervention and 3 and 6 month follow up.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: One hundred and seventy-four expressed interest, 92 were eligible and 65 enrolled.
label: none

sentence: Using linear mixed effects models, the differences between groups on all secondary measures post-intervention and at follow-up were not significant.
label: none

label: none

sentence: Only the SCT group improved at 3 and 6 month follow up in physical impact of MS(−4.45(−8.68, −0.22), −4.12(−8.25, 0.01), anxiety(−1.76(−3.20, −0.31), −1.99(−3.28, −0.71), depression(−1.51(−2.89, −0.13), −1.02(−2.05, 0.01)) and cognition(5.04(2.51, 7.57), 3.05(0.81, 5.28), with a medium effect for cognition and fitness (Hedges’ g 0.75(0.24, 1.25), 0.51(0.01, 1.00) at 3 month follow up.

label: none

sentence: There were no statistically significant differences between groups for the secondary outcomes once age, gender, time since diagnosis and type of MS were accounted for.
label: none

sentence: However, within the SCT group only there were improvements in anxiety, depression, cognition and physical impact of MS.

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic and often progressive condition affecting the central nervous system.
label: none

sentence: MS has many consequences, including impaired strength, fitness, mood, fatigue and cognition, along with limitations of activities such as walking that impact on quality of life.
label: none

sentence: Available evidence supports the beneficial effects of exercise on fatigue [1, 2], depression [3] fitness [4], walking mobility [5, 6], in addition to quality of life [7].
label: none

sentence: Indeed, this evidence has led to the development of the MS Exercise guideline [8, 9] which recommends moderate intensity aerobic exercise for 30 min and resistance training involving major muscle groups twice weekly.
label: none

sentence: We are not aware of a single trial that has actually documented the benefits of the exercise guidelines in MS. Of further concern, there are few studies in the MS exercise literature that have evaluated the long-term benefits of exercise interventions, and the results are mixed.
label: none

sentence: For example, we reported positive improvements from a combined aerobic and resistance exercise programme in the community [10]; however, the improvements generally were not maintained 12 weeks post-intervention [11], suggesting that additional measures are required to enable sustained increases in physical activity behaviour among PwMS.
label: none

sentence: This need to foster long-term exercise participation is not unique to PwMS and authors have highlighted the need to include theory-based behaviour change interventions [12].
label: none

sentence: Social cognitive theory has been extensively investigated among PwMS, and exercise self-efficacy and goal setting are consistently associated with [13] and predictive of [14] physical activity behaviour.
label: none

sentence: Indeed a recent meta-analysis demonstrated significant associations of these constructs and outcome expectancies with physical activity [15].
label: none

sentence: We have conducted a series of clinical trials (i.e., Phase I and II) with relatively small samples for examining the efficacy of an Internet-delivered behavioural intervention based on social cognitive theory (SCT) for increasing physical activity among ambulatory persons with MS [16–19].
label: none

sentence: Our most recent trial included the website and one-one-one video coaching and demonstrated moderate to large improvements in minutes/day of moderate/vigorous physical activity, endurance walking performance, information processing speed, symptoms of fatigue, depression, anxiety, and pain, and quality of life (QOL) over a six-month period [20].
label: none

sentence: Collectively, such data support the efficacy of the behavioural intervention for increasing and sustaining physical activity in PwMS and possibly improving walking, cognition  symptoms, and QOL outcomes.
label: none

sentence: The Step it Up study [21] combined the collective knowledge and expertise gained from the Irish community exercise programme with the U.S. online intervention.
label: none

sentence: The 10-week programme firstly aimed to enable inactive PwMS to reach the recently published aerobic and resistance exercise guidelines.
label: none

sentence: We further investigated how embedding this exercise programme in a structured SCT-based education intervention compared to an attention-control education intervention.
label: none

sentence: The current paper reports the results for the secondary outcomes of MS symptoms, physical activity, and SCT constructs.
label: none

sentence: The primary outcome and feasibility metrics, presented elsewhere (Hayes et al.
label: none

sentence: in press) demonstrated that both groups improved significantly in the primary outcome, the six minute walk test (6MWT), and this improvement was maintained at 6 month follow-up.
label: none

sentence: An exploratory analysis of those with three of four assessments demonstrated that the SCT group had a ~ 40 m greater improvement in 6MWT than the control group post-intervention and at 6-month follow up (p = 0.04 for both).

label: none

sentence: Inclusion criteria were: (1) physician-confirmed formal diagnosis of MS, (2) aged 18 years or more, (3) Patient Determined Disease Steps (PDDS) scale score of 0–3, (4) a sedentary lifestyle (<30 min of moderate to strenuous exercise one day or more per week over the last six months) and (5) willing to give written informed consent.
label: none

In order to have 80% power (at the 5% significance level) to detect such a difference in mean improvement in 6MWT over the study period between groups, a sample of size 62 randomised equally to two arms (i.e.

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: This paper presents the secondary outcome results from an intervention designed to enable inactive people with MS to reach the minimum recommendation of the MS Exercise Guidelines and further compared the effect of a structured SCT-based education to an attention-control education intervention.
label: none

sentence: The Health Index score of the GLTEQ also increased in both groups, confirming the exercise log data which indicated that SCT and the CON group groups completed an average of 33.2 of 44 available sessions (75.5%) and 32.0 sessions (72.6%), respectively (Hayes et al.

sentence: This may be due to reduced non-exercise physical activity, such that participants reduced leisure, transport and occupational PA in order to engage in exercise training, thereby maintaining, or even decreasing, their overall PA levels.

sentence: There has been some support in the literature for initial decreases in non-exercise physical activity when beginning an exercise training intervention, though the available evidence suggests that decreased activity dissipates with continued training [46].

sentence: It is also possible that the arm worn accelerometer did not capture the changes in PA or that an alternative output, such as increased mild/moderate PA specifically or a reduction in sedentary behaviour, may capture the changes due to the intervention.

sentence: Importantly, the results of within-group changes confirmed the positive effect of exercise on fatigue for people with MS [1, 2].

sentence: Strengths and limitations
label: none

sentence: The main strength of this study is that we purposely recruited inactive people with MS and engaged them in a 10-week exercise and education programme with the aim of enabling long-term physical activity engagement and its associated benefits.
label: none

sentence: A weakness is that we did not power the study for these secondary outcomes; nonetheless, the preliminary findings presented in the current paper, particularly the magnitude of improvements in fatigue, anxiety and depressive symptoms, the perceived impact of MS, strength and aerobic capacity, and cognitive processing speed, will inform future trials and targeted analyses of these important factors.
label: limitation

sentence: A further strength is that we measured a broad range of MS symptoms, and reported the effect of the resistance and aerobic exercise programme on strength, fitness, and subjectively and objectively measured PA. A limitation is that the measures of objective PA and fitness did not change and a more direct measure of fitness, such as cycle ergometry to determine VO2 max, is recommended [50].
label: limitation

sentence: Participants reported some dissatisfaction with the SWA arm band; therefore, alternative tools for objectively measuring PA among PwMS are warranted.

sentence: A further strength is that we used exercise logs to capture intensity of aerobic exercise using steps from a pedometer, but a limitation is that we did not record heart rate and this is recommended in future trials.

sentence: Conclusion
label: none

sentence: This paper presents data to suggest that enabling inactive people with mild-moderate disability due to MS to exercise at the minimum suggested by the exercise guideline results in a range of benefits.
label: none

sentence: Improvements in fatigue, strength, goal setting and planning were seen in both the structured SCT and attention control groups and were maintained at 3 and 6 month follow up.
label: none

sentence: The similar responses in both groups for these secondary outcomes can be explained as they both had the same exercise intervention and by the inadvertent inclusion of several behaviour change techniques for the control group through our adherence logging and trial structure.
label: none

sentence: The results of this pilot trial for the secondary outcome measures suggest that the SCT group had greater improvements in cognitive processing and aerobic capacity at 3 month follow up.
label: none

sentence: This paper further presents preliminary evidence for improvements in physical impact of MS, anxiety, depression and cognition in the exercise plus SCT group alone.
label: none

sentence: This may in part be due to the greater improvements in walking mobility reported elsewhere or due to the content of the education element and therefore further testing of the intervention model is warranted.
label: none

sentence: These findings, in combination with the effects for the primary outcome measure, warrant progression to a definitive RCT and suggest the importance of studies directly investigating the dose-response relationship with focal outcomes.

sentence: Hepatic, adipocyte, enteric and pancreatic hormones: response to dietary macronutrient composition and relationship with metabolism
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: We sought to characterize the effects of dietary macronutrient composition on various hormones implicated in the regulation of insulin sensitivity (IS) and energy expenditure (EE).
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: Following 10–15% weight loss, 21 overweight subjects consumed 3 weight-loss maintenance diets [low fat (LF), low glycemic index (LGI) and very low carbohydrate (VLC)] in random order, each for 4 weeks.
label: none

sentence: At baseline and at the end of each treatment period, fasting samples for fibroblast growth factor (FGF)-21, heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1), chemerin, irisin, secreted frizzle-related protein (SFRP-4), total bile acids, ghrelin, gastrin inhibitory peptide (GIP), peptide-Y, and amylin; hepatic and peripheral IS; and EE were obtained.
label: none

sentence: Analyses were controlled for age, gender, baseline body mass index, and diet sequence.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: FGF-21 decreased (P < 0.0001), with differential effect by macronutrient composition (mean change from baseline ± SEM: LF −49.4 ± 16.6, LGI -58.6 ± 16.3, VLC -76.7 ± 18.2 pg/mL, P = 0.0002).
label: none

sentence: Change in FGF-21 was inversely associated with change in hepatic IS [Beta = −0.565 units/log(ng/mL), P = 0.02], but not with peripheral IS or EE.
label: none

sentence: Heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1) increased (P = 0.003), without differential effect by macronutrient composition (LF 0.40 ± 0.26, LGI 0.98 ± 0.63, VLC 0.49 ± 0.29 ng/mL, P = 0.07).
label: none

sentence: Ghrelin increased (P = 0.0003), while chemerin decreased (P = 0.001) without macronutrient effect.
label: none

sentence: Total bile acid, irisin, SFRP-4, GIP, peptide-Y and amylin levels did not change.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: FGF-21 levels decreased with dietary intervention in proportion to carbohydrate content, and correlated with hepatic insulin sensitivity, suggesting a pattern of improving FGF-21 resistance.
label: none

sentence: HO-1 increased in response to dietary intervention, a tendency to greater increase in response to the LGI diet.
label: none

sentence: Dietary intervention affected ghrelin and chemerin, independent of macronutrient composition.
label: none

sentence: These findings may elucidate relationships between dietary composition, insulin sensitivity and metabolism.
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Previous data suggest that dietary composition modulates weight-loss induced changes in energy expenditure, insulin sensitivity and satiety.
label: none

sentence: For instance, among subjects following a feeding protocol, energy expenditure decreased by approximately 325 kcal/day more following a low fat vs. low carb diet controlled for energy intake [1].
label: none

sentence: Other studies have reported metabolic benefits and improved satiety with reduction of glycemic load [2, 3], but the mechanisms mediating these effects remain incompletely described.
label: none

sentence: Hormones secreted from the gastrointestinal tract and related organs have been implicated in these relationships.
label: none

sentence: Fibroblast growth factor (FGF)-21, secreted by the liver, enhances glucose uptake into adipocytes [4].
label: none

sentence: Administration of FGF-21 to humans modestly decreases body weight [5], and in animal models improves insulin sensitivity, energy expenditure and hepatic steatosis [6], with maximal effect at low doses.
label: none

sentence: However, FGF-21 levels are elevated in humans with obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus [7], in association with markers of metabolic syndrome, which suggests a pattern of FGF-21 resistance [8] that may comprise a fourth component of the obesity-related resistance triad of insulin, leptin and sympathetic tone.
label: none

sentence: Indeed, FGF-21 levels decrease with bariatric surgery [9], although the effect of diet induced weight loss has not been well-characterized.
label: none

sentence: Chemerin, a novel hepatocyte and adipocyte-derived hormone, is a chemoattractant for tissue injury that regulates adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis.
label: none

sentence: Chemerin levels are increased in obesity [10] and correlate with degree of fatty liver [11].
label: none

sentence: Chemerin levels decrease with weight loss from diet [12] and bariatric surgery [11] but effects of dietary macronutrient composition are unknown.
label: none

sentence: Bile acids, also produced by hepatocytes, modulate body weight, insulin sensitivity and energy expenditure in rodent models [13], though little is known about the effects of weight loss or dietary composition in humans.
label: none

sentence: Heme oxygenase (HO)-1 is secreted by adipose tissue and reduces oxidative stress.
label: none

sentence: Induction in animals decreases body weight, inflammatory cytokine profiles, and insulin resistance [14].
label: none

sentence: Levels are elevated in patients with type 2 diabetes [15], but the effects of weight loss and dietary composition on HO-1 are unknown.
label: none

sentence: Several novel proteins have recently emerged as potential mediators of insulin dynamics and energy expenditure.
label: none

sentence: Secreted frizzle-related protein-4 (SFRP-4) is a newly discovered pancreatic protein that decreases insulin secretion [16].
label: none

sentence: Levels are elevated in subjects with type 2 diabetes, and appear to precede the development of type 2 diabetes [16].
label: none

sentence: The myokine irisin stimulates uncoupling protein-1 expression in adipocytes and prevents diet-induced obesity and diabetes in mouse models [17].
label: none

sentence: Serum irisin levels are lower in patients with obesity and hepatic steatosis [18], and increase with exercise [17].
label: none

sentence: The effects of diet-induced weight loss in adults and dietary composition on SFRP-4 and irisin levels are not well-characterized.
label: none

sentence: Multiple enteric and pancreatic hormones have emerged as important mediators of food intake.
label: none

sentence: Ghrelin, secreted from the stomach, rises acutely with fasting to stimulate hunger, and increases with weight loss [19].
label: none

sentence: Peptide-YY (PYY), secreted by the distal ileum, increases with nutritional intake to convey a satiety signal.
label: none

sentence: PYY levels decrease with diet-induced weight loss [19].
label: none

sentence: Amylin, which is co-secreted by the pancreas with insulin, decreases food intake and body weight [20], and levels decrease in response to weight-loss maintenance [19].
label: none

sentence: Taken together, this pattern of hormonal alterations can contribute to weight regain [19].
label: none

sentence: Gastric inhibitory polypeptide (GIP) is secreted by K cells in the duodenum in response to intraluminal glucose and fat.
label: none

sentence: Mice lacking GIP receptor are protected against diet-induced obesity, due to higher energy expenditure, and insulin resistance [21].
label: none

sentence: In the setting of weight maintenance, GIP levels tend to be lower in response to low glycemic index diets [22].
label: none

sentence: The effects of weight loss on GIP levels are less clear.
label: none

sentence: In this study, we aimed to characterize the changes in these metabolic hormones in response to weight loss and diets varying in composition, and analyze the potential contribution of these hormones to changes in physiology and metabolism.
label: none

sentence: The overall study design was previously reported [1].

sentence: In brief, participants who were overweight or obese, and otherwise healthy, achieved 10–15% weight-loss over 12 weeks by consuming a standardized reduced-calorie diet providing 60% of estimated needs and consisting of 45% carbohydrate, 30% fat and 25% protein.
label: none

sentence: Participants then received each of 3 weight loss maintenance test diets for 4 weeks in random order (Figure 1).
label: none

sentence: The diets were isocaloric, designed to achieve 100% of estimated caloric needs, but varied in macronutrient composition as follows: low fat (60% carbohydrate, 20% fat and 20% protein), low glycemic index (40% carbohydrate, 40% fat and 20% protein), and very low carbohydrate (10% carbohydrate, 60% fat, 30% protein).
label: none

sentence: All study meals were designed and prepared in the metabolic kitchen at the Brigham and Women’s Hospital (BWH).
label: none

sentence: Participants consumed one meal each weekday on site, with remainder of meals and snacks packaged for consumption at home, and completed a daily compliance diary.
label: none

sentence: Participants were admitted to BWH or Boston Children’s Hospital for a four-day hospitalization at baseline (prior to weight loss) and after each of the three test diets (during period of weight maintenance).
label: none

sentence: At each study visit, a full assessment was performed, including resting energy expenditure, insulin sensitivity and measurement of metabolic hormones.
label: none

sentence: As previously reported [1], resting energy expenditure was measured by indirect calorimetry and total energy expenditure was measured under free living conditions by doubly-labeled water technique.
label: none

sentence: Hepatic and peripheral insulin sensitivity were calculated from glucose and insulin responses to oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) as per Abdul-Ghani et al.
label: none

sentence: For hepatic insulin sensitivity, we calculated the product of the glucose and insulin areas under the curve during the first 30 min of the OGTT and then obtained the inverse.
label: none

sentence: For peripheral insulin sensitivity, we calculated the rate of decline of glucose levels from peak to nadir during the OGTT and then divided by mean insulin levels.
label: none

sentence: Participants maintained their habitual levels of physical activity throughout the course of the study.
label: none

sentence: [1] The study was approved by the Boston Children’s Hospital and Partner’s Institutional Review Boards, and registered on clinicaltrials.gov (NCT00315354).

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: The main finding from this study is that FGF-21 levels decreased in response to dietary intervention with marked effect by macronutrient composition.
label: none

sentence: Owing to differences in assay type, the absolute values of FGF-21 in our study are lower than some published reports [26], yet consistent with more recent publications [27, 28].
label: none

sentence: The greatest reduction in FGF-21 occurred on the very low carbohydrate diet.
label: none

sentence: This finding extends recent observations that consumption of carbohydrate, specifically sugar, increases FGF-21 levels [29–32] and affects preference for sweets [30, 32], and that changes in sweet preference occur with sugar restriction.
label: none

sentence: While the exact mechanism by which FGF-21 responds to nutrient intake is unclear, FGF-21 is stimulated by FFA [33], insulin [33] and ketones [34], and is necessary for changes in lipid and glucose metabolism induced by very low carbohydrate diets [35].
label: none

sentence: In our study, the effect of diet on FGF-21 was independent of FFA concentration, suggesting an alternate mechanism.
label: none

sentence: We speculate (but cannot prove) that the decrease in FGF-21 increased FGF-21 sensitivity, as evidenced by the close relationship with other physiologically relevant variables.
label: none

sentence: Decreases in FGF-21 levels correlated with improvements in hepatic insulin sensitivity, consistent with previous studies showing that FGF-21 administration improves hepatic insulin sensitivity [34].
label: none

sentence: In this context, our findings suggest that obesity comprises a state of FGF-21 resistance.
label: none

sentence: This hypothesis is in accordance with recently published data suggesting decreased FGF-21 with weight loss in an adolescent population [36].
label: none

sentence: In addition, the results raise concern for the proposed use of FGF-21 as pharmacologic treatment in obesity until physiological actions are further clarified [35].
label: none

sentence: This scenario may be analogous to leptin treatment in obesity and insulin treatment in type 2 diabetes, in which endogenous hormone resistance may limit efficacy and result in side effects.
label: none

sentence: We also measured several other novel obesity-related hormones.
label: none

sentence: Our data are the first to demonstrate that circulating heme oxygenase-1 levels increase with dietary intervention, which may be an endogenous anti-inflammatory response to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation [14], though the clinical significance remains unclear.
label: none

sentence: Though not statistically significant, the largest improvement in HO-1 levels was seen in response to the low glycemic index diet.
label: none

sentence: While there is very little data regarding nutritional regulation of HO-1, this effect may have arisen as a direct result of macronutrient composition on HO-1 or indirectly via weight-loss induced improvement in insulin action [37].
label: none

sentence: We show that chemerin, a chemoattractant for tissue injury, decreased with dietary intervention, similar to previous reports [12].
label: none

sentence: The improved cytokine profile is most likely a response to weight loss, but may also reflect improved dietary quality.
label: none

sentence: We also measured the novel hormones SFRP-4, a biochemical harbinger of type 2 diabetes [16], and irisin, the myokine that may mediate beneficial effects of exercise [17], and bile acids, implicated in regulation of energy expenditure [13].
label: none

sentence: These did not change throughout the study.
label: none

sentence: Consistent with previous data [19], fasting ghrelin levels decreased after dietary intervention without specific effect of dietary composition.
label: none

sentence: While very low carbohydrate diets are typically associated with improved satiety and decreased post-prandial intake [3], ghrelin levels did not change across the test diets, likely the result of the complex regulation of hunger.
label: none

sentence: In contrast to previous data [19], we did not observe effects of dietary intervention on the satiety hormones PYY or amylin.
label: none

sentence: The primary limitation to these analyses is that hormone concentrations were not measured immediately following the weight loss period.
label: limitation

sentence: In addition, multiple comparisons may increase the false discovery rate.
label: limitation

sentence: Nevertheless, our primary findings regarding FGF-21 would withstand adjustment for multiple comparisons.
label: none

sentence: Dietary adherence was measured using a daily diary as completed by the participant.
label: none

sentence: The clear differentiation in several metabolic variables with known dietary effects, such as triglycerides [previously discussed by Ebbeling et al.
label: none

sentence: [1]], suggests excellent compliance.
label: none

sentence: Strengths include a rigorously conducted feeding protocol, outstanding retention rate, and a crossover design allowing for maximal power and control for unmeasured confounding variables.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: In summary, FGF-21 levels decreased in response to dietary interventions varying in macronutrient content, likely secondary to decreasing carbohydrate content, and correlated with hepatic insulin sensitivity.

sentence: Anti-inflammatory treatment improves high-density lipoprotein function in rheumatoid arthritis
label: none

sentence: Objective
label: none

sentence: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) are at increased cardiovascular risk.
label: none

sentence: Recent studies suggest that high-density lipoprotein (HDL) may lose its protective vascular phenotype in inflammatory conditions.
label: none

sentence: However, the effects of common anti-inflammatory treatments on HDL function are not yet known.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: We compared the function of HDL in 18 patients with RA and 18 matched healthy controls.
label: none

sentence: Subsequently, patients were randomised to (methotrexate+infliximab (M+I) (5 mg/kg)) or methotrexate+placebo (M+P) infusions for 54 weeks.
label: none

sentence: At week 54 and thereafter, all patients received infliximab therapy until completion of the trial (110 weeks), enabling assessment of the impact of 1 year of infliximab therapy in all patients.
label: none

sentence: HDL functional properties were assessed at baseline, 54 weeks and 110 weeks by measuring the impact on endothelial nitric oxide (NO) bioavailability and superoxide production (SO), paraoxonase activity (PON-1) and cholesterol efflux.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: All HDL vascular assays were impaired in patients compared with controls.
label: none

sentence: After 54 weeks, NO in response to HDL was significantly greater in patients who received M+I compared with those who received M+P.
label: none

sentence: Endothelial SO in response to HDL was reduced in both groups, but PON-1 and cholesterol efflux remained unchanged.
label: none

sentence: All vascular measures improved compared with baseline after ≥1 infliximab therapy in the analysis at 110 weeks.
label: none

sentence: No significant trend was noted for cholesterol efflux.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: HDL function can be improved with anti-inflammatory treatment in patients with RA.
label: none

sentence: The M+I combination was superior to the M+P alone, suggesting that the tumour necrosis factor-α pathway may have a role in HDL vascular properties.
label: none

sentence: Introduction
label: none

sentence: Cardiovascular (CV) disease remains the leading cause of morbidity and mortality in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA).
label: none

sentence: Conventional risk factors do not account fully for this, and increased levels of inflammation associated with RA may be an important determinant of CV outcomes.
label: none

sentence: In a study of 651 patients, an elevated inflammatory state was associated with an increased CV event rate but a paradoxical reduction in circulating lipid levels.
label: none

sentence: This suggests that the relationship between lipid levels and increased CV disease is altered in RA and may be explained, at least in part, by qualitative changes to lipoproteins as a result of the inflammatory milieu.
label: none

sentence: High-density lipoprotein (HDL) has been suggested to exert anti-atherosclerotic effects via reverse cholesterol transport and activation of protective endothelial pathways.
label: none

sentence: In conditions such as RA however, HDL has been shown to acquire pro-inflammatory and pro-thrombotic phenotype that can promote atherogenesis and potentially increase CV risk.
label: none

sentence: A previous study from our group demonstrated that the beneficial function of HDL can be restored after resolution of acute inflammatory stimulus, suggesting that the modification of systemic inflammation offers potential for CV risk reduction.
label: none

sentence: In our current study, we examined the influence of standard (methotrexate (MTX)) and novel anti-inflammatory treatments (infliximab) on HDL function in patients with RA in a randomised controlled trial over 1 year.
label: none

sentence: We also assessed the long-term effect of infliximab on HDL function and CV and RA risk factors.
label: none

sentence: Our findings support the concept that HDL dysfunction can be improved by anti-inflammatory drugs that are widely used for RA therapy and this may confer CV benefit.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: Study population and protocol
label: none

sentence: RA population
label: none

sentence: We studied 18 patients with early erosive RA who were required to have (i) a diagnosis of RA according to the American College of Rheumatology 1987 criteria, (ii) symptoms for 6 months—3 years, (iii) a minimum of two swollen metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints despite treatment with MTX and (iv) seropositivity for IgM rheumatoid factor.
label: none

sentence: In addition, eligible patients were required to have either (i) erosion of ≥1 MCP joint as demonstrated on plain radiography or as a cortical break with irregular margins (or contour) on greyscale ultrasound in both the longitudinal and transverse scanning planes or (ii) erosions of ≥2 MCP joints (cortical breaks with irregular margins/contour on greyscale ultrasound in either the transverse or the longitudinal plane associated with a strong vascular signal in power Doppler mode at the site of the cortical break).
label: none

sentence: All patients received oral MTX for greater than or equal to at least 8 weeks, at a minimum stable dosage of 12.5 mg/week but not exceeding 17.5 mg/week.
label: none

sentence: Patients being treated with oral corticosteroids must have been receiving a stable dosage (10 mg prednisolone per day) for 4 weeks.
label: none

sentence: Study 1: case–control study
label: none

sentence: Vascular properties of HDL from 18 patients with RA were compared with 18 healthy control subjects.
label: none

sentence: Healthy controls had no CV risk factors by history, clinical examination and laboratory tests, and were matched to patients with RA for age and gender.
label: none

sentence: Study 2: randomised clinical trial (double-blind phase)—secondary analysis
label: none

sentence: All physicians, patients, nurses and other non-clinical members of the study team were blinded for the first year of the study.
label: none

sentence: Eighteen patients with RA were randomised into one of two treatment groups by a pharmacist who did not participate in the screening visit.
label: none

sentence: Eleven patients received infusions of infliximab at 5 mg/kg and seven received placebo (normal saline) infusions at weeks 0, 2 and 6, and then every 8 weeks through week 46.
label: none

sentence: At the end of the first year, all patients were maintained a single-blinded study for a further year.
label: none

sentence: Patients in the methotrexate+infliximab (M+I ) group received infliximab infusions at weeks 54, 56, 62 and thereafter every 8 weeks.
label: none

sentence: Those in the M+I group received a placebo infusion at week 56 in order to maintain blinding and received infliximab infusions every 8 weeks until the end of the study (110 weeks) (see online supplementary appendix figure 1).
label: none

sentence: As a result, all patients received a minimum of 1 year of infliximab in the two phases of the study.
label: none

sentence: Baseline dosages of MTX or corticosteroid were maintained during the first 18 weeks of the study.
label: none

sentence: After week 18, if any patient failed to achieve a 50% reduction from baseline in the number of swollen hand and wrist joints, the weekly dose of MTX was increased by 2.5 mg once every 4 weeks until a 50% reduction from baseline in the number of swollen hand and wrist joints was achieved, until the dosage of oral MTX reached 25 mg/week or until the dose escalation was limited by toxicity.
label: none

sentence: Thereafter, irrespective of their response status, patients continued to receive the maximum tolerated MTX dosage until the end of the study.
label: none

sentence: The study was approved by Riverside Research Ethics Committee, and all patients provided informed consent.
label: none

sentence: Clinical monitoring of the study was performed independently (Centocor, Malvern, Pennsylvania, USA).
label: none

sentence: Anthropometric and biochemical measurements
label: none

label: none

sentence: Blood pressure was measured in triplicate (HEM-705CP, Omron), and the average of the readings was calculated.
label: none

sentence: Blood was drawn and processed after an overnight fast, and serum and plasma samples were stored at −70°C for subsequent analysis.
label: none

sentence: HDL measurements
label: none

sentence: Measurements of HDL function were carried out at baseline, 54 weeks and 110 weeks in patients with RA.
label: none

sentence: Baseline measurements were compared with those from healthy controls.
label: none

sentence: HDL isolation
label: none

sentence: HDL was isolated by sequential ultracentrifugation (d=1.063–1.21 g/mL) using solid potassium bromide for density adjustment.
label: none

sentence: All functional assays of HDL were carried out within two weeks of isolation by a blinded investigator in duplicate.
label: none

sentence: Endothelial nitric oxide bioavailability
label: none

sentence: The effect of HDL (50 μg/mL: 60 min, 37°C) on endothelial nitric oxide (NO) bioavailability (bovine aortic endothelial cells (BAECs): passage 4–7; Lonza Bioscience) was measured using a fluorescent indicator.
label: none

sentence: BAECs were incubated with 4,5-diaminofluorescein diacetate (DAF-2; 1Um; Cayman Chemical), and triazolofluorescein fluorescence was measured using an excitation wavelength of 485 nm.
label: none

sentence: Endothelial superoxide production
label: none

sentence: The effect of HDL on endothelial cell superoxide production (SO) was measured in unstimulated and tumour necrosis factor-α (TNF-α)-stimulated (5 ng/mL, R&D Systems) human aortic endothelial cells (HAECs) by erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) spectroscopy.
label: none

sentence: HAECs were incubated with HDL from patients and controls (50 μg/mL, 60 min, 37°C), with or without TNF-α and resuspended in Krebs-Hepes buffer (pH 7.4; Noxygen) containing diethyldithiocarbamic acid sodium salt (5 μM, Noxygen) and deferoxamine methanesulfonate salt (25 μM, Noxygen).
label: none

sentence: ESR spectra were recorded after addition of the spin probe 1-hydroxy-3-methoxycarbonyl-2,2,5,5-tetramethylpyrrolidine (CMH; Noxygen; final concentration 200 μM) using a Bruker e-scan spectrometer (Bruker Biospin).
label: none

sentence: The ESR instrumental settings were centre field (B0) 3495 G; field sweep width 10 G; microwave frequency 9.75 GHz; microwave power 19.91 mW; magnetic field modulation frequency 86.00 kHz; modulation amplitude 2.60 G; conversion time 10.24 ms; and number of x-scans 1020.
label: none

sentence: Cholesterol efflux capacity
label: none

sentence: HDL for measurements of efflux capacity was extracted from serum by ApoB depletion.
label: none

sentence: Whole serum was incubated for 20 min with a 20% polyethylene glycol (PEG) solution (20% PEG 8000 (sigma P2139) in 200 mM glycine (sigma G8898, pH=10)).
label: none

sentence: Samples were centrifuged at 1900 g, and the supernatant was collected and stored at 4°C.
label: none

sentence: J774 cells were radiolabeled for 24 hours in a medium containing 2 μCi of [3H]-cholesterol per microlitre.
label: none

sentence: Addition of 0.3 mM 8-(4-chlorophenylthio)-cyclic AMP for 6 hours upregulated expression of ABCA1.
label: none

sentence: An efflux medium containing 2.8% apolipoprotein B-depleted serum from each individual was added for 4 hours.
label: none

sentence: To prevent cholesterol esterification during labelling, equilibration and flux, 2 μg/mL of CP113,818, a acyl-coenzyme A:cholesterol acyltransferase inhibitor was added to all mediums.
label: none

sentence: Efflux capacity was quantified using liquid scintillation to measure radioactive cholesterol effluxed from the cells (medium+intracellular lipids).
label: none

sentence: All assays were performed in duplicate and the final average value normalised against a baseline control for statistical analyses between time points.
label: none

sentence: Paraoxonase-1 activity
label: none

sentence: Serum paraoxonase activities were measured by ultraviolet spectrophotometry in a 96-well plate format using paraoxon (Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis, Missouri, USA).
label: none

sentence: Briefly, 50 μg/mL HDL was diluted in a reaction mixture containing 10 mM Tris hydrochloride (pH 8.0), 1 M sodium chloride and 2 mM calcium chloride.
label: none

sentence: At 24°C, 1.5 mM paraoxon was added to initiate the reaction, and the increase in absorbance at 405 nm was recorded over 30 min.
label: none

sentence: An extinction coefficient (at 405 nm) of 17 000 M−1 • cm−1 was used to calculate units of paraoxonase-1 (PON-1).
label: none

sentence: Statistics
label: none

sentence: HDL studies were powered for a 1:1 randomised controlled trial on the basis of NO bioavailability using paired assessments in 35 healthy controls (mean=0.98, SD =0.13, and intraclass correlation 0.91).
label: none

sentence: From this power calculation, a total of seven patients per group was required (power=80% and α=0.05) to detect a 5% difference in the primary outcome (NO bioavailability).
label: none

sentence: Normal distribution was assessed using the Shapiro-Wilk test.
label: none

label: none

sentence: Post hoc multivariate analysis of variance (ANOVA) modelling was performed to evaluate the effects of treatment with infliximab (vs placebo) and duration of treatment on HDL function, CV and clinical markers at 54 weeks.
label: none

sentence: A repeated-measures ANOVA, with time point comparisons using Bonferroni-corrected t-tests, was performed to determine differences in HDL function, CV and clinical markers in patients who received 2 years infliximab treatment.
label: none

sentence: The Greenhouse-Geisser correction for the F test was used to adjust the degrees of freedom for deviation from sphericity.
label: none

sentence: Analysis was performed using GraphPad Prism analysis software.

sentence: A two-sided p value of <0.05 was considered to indicate statistical significance.

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: This study shows that anti-inflammatory treatments can improve the antioxidant and endothelial protective properties of HDL in patients with erosive RA.
label: none

sentence: These effects were not accompanied by changes in cholesterol efflux and tracked improvements in RA disease activity.
label: none

sentence: Treatment with infliximab in addition to MTX for 2 years showed a benefit for a broad range of HDL functional properties including NO bioavailability, SO production and PON-1 activity.
label: none

sentence: These findings suggest that there is a role for anti-inflammatory treatments, particularly those targeting the TNF-α pathway, for improving not only RA disease activity but also potentially CV risk factors in patients with RA.
label: none

sentence: The threefold increased risk of CV disease in patients with RA is not accounted for by traditional risk factors and is related to increased levels of inflammation.
label: none

sentence: This influences a range of CV risk factors and causes quantitative and qualitative changes to lipoproteins.
label: none

sentence: Substantial evidence has now accumulated, suggesting that inflammation can convert the normally protective HDL into a ‘particle with adverse effects on endothelial function’.
label: none

sentence: We showed that HDL has several dysfunctional properties in patients with RA, which may contribute to their increased CV risk.
label: none

sentence: Our findings are in agreement with previous evidence describing a pro-inflammatory HDL particle with reduced PON-1 activity.
label: none

sentence: We have now demonstrated an impairment of the beneficial effects of HDL on endothelium with a marked decrease in the stimulation of endothelial NO and increase in SO production compared with healthy controls.
label: none

sentence: Diminished production of NO may reflect endothelial dysfunction, an early step in atherogenesis, and represents a novel pathway by which HDL dysfunction can promote arterial disease in patients with RA.
label: none

sentence: We evaluated the potential for HDL function to be restored following treatment with RA anti-inflammatory therapies.
label: none

sentence: MTX is commonly used as a first-line treatment in early RA.
label: none

sentence: Observational studies have demonstrated reduced rates of myocardial infarction and stroke with MTX therapy and the ongoing CIRT trial is evaluating the drug in secondary CV prevention.
label: none

sentence: Its exact anti-inflammatory mechanisms remain uncertain, although it has been shown to mediate increased extracellular accumulation of adenosine around connective tissue and reduce levels of CRP and interleukin-6.
label: none

sentence: Biological inhibition of TNF-α with infliximab in addition to MTX is a more effective approach for reducing RA disease activity.
label: none

sentence: TNF-α is a proximal cytokine and its blockade has well-established anti-inflammatory actions and effects on lipid metabolism.
label: none

sentence: At 54 weeks, NO bioavailability was significantly improved in patients who received infliximab, but not with MTX.
label: none

sentence: Infliximab has previously been associated with increased AKT/eNOS phosphorylation and improved endothelial function.
label: none

sentence: Our study provides a novel mechanism by which infliximab can improve endothelial function and contribute to vascular protection by TNF-α inhibition.
label: none

sentence: After 1 year of our double-blinded randomised trial, SO production was significantly reduced in both arms.
label: none

sentence: MTX is known to inhibit several inflammatory and oxidative stress mediators, associated with increased lipid peroxidation.
label: none

sentence: Oxidative modification of the HDL particle alters its protective phenotype.
label: none

sentence: Combination therapy with infliximab caused an additional reduction of SO production compared with MTX alone.
label: none

sentence: Previous studies of infliximab in humans suggest that TNF-α inhibition protects against oxidative DNA damage and lipid peroxidation, and this may explain its additional efficacy in reducing SO production.
label: none

sentence: Despite a trend towards an increased benefit of infliximab therapy at 1 year, between-treatment comparisons did not reach statistical significance.
label: none

sentence: Assay of PON-1 provided an additional measure of the antioxidative function of HDL but no significant difference was found in the double-blinded randomised study in either arm at 1 year possibly due to the small sample size.
label: limitation

sentence: However, PON-1 activity was improved in the single-blinded study at 1 and 2 years treatment of infliximab.
label: none

sentence: While the effect of MTX on PON-1 activity has not previously been reported, infliximab is known to improve PON-1 activity through the reduction of lipid peroxidation including myeloperoxidase (MPO) pathways.
label: none

sentence: Site-specific oxidative modification of PON-1 by MPO impairs the enzymes ability to bind with APOA-1 and reduced MPO could explain the increased PON-1 activity in our patients.
label: none

sentence: We did not demonstrate any differences in cholesterol efflux with either treatment regimen.
label: none

sentence: This suggests that anti-inflammatory therapies have a more pronounced impact on the vascular properties of HDL than on its efflux capacity.
label: none

sentence: These findings support previous reports from our group and indicate that the endothelial function of HDL may be more sensitive to modification than cholesterol efflux.
label: none

sentence: However, anti-inflammatory treatments including MTX and infliximab have recently been associated with improved cholesterol efflux in patients with RA, and associated with CV disease in both healthy and at-risk populations.
label: none

sentence: These differences may be due to methodological issues in the efflux measurement and their interpretation, and require further investigation.
label: none

sentence: Our study was not powered to assess the quantitative relationship between HDL function, inflammation and disease activity.
label: limitation

sentence: This also limited our ability to test for between-treatment differences in the randomised study design, although combination therapy demonstrated a clear benefit in the single-blinded study.
label: limitation

sentence: However, we have demonstrated that a range of vascular properties of HDL can be improved with anti-inflammatory drug therapy.
label: none

sentence: HDL function did not return to normal levels following treatment, and this is likely to be as a result of the residual levels of inflammation even after 2 years treatment (data not shown).
label: none

sentence: The ability of anti-inflammatory treatments to modify CV risk remains an intense area of clinical research.
label: none

sentence: Currently, three anti-inflammatory agents are the subject of phase III trials; MTX (CIRT), Darapladib (SOLID-TMI and STABILITY) and canakinumab (CANTOS).
label: none

sentence: Recently, both the STABILITY and SOLID-TMI trials reported that darapladib failed to reduce the risk of CV death and myocardial infarction in primary and secondary prevention.
label: none

sentence: The CIRT and CANTOS trials are due to report shortly, but our data suggest that monotherapy with MTX alone may not be sufficient.
label: none

sentence: Inhibition of TNF-α, a broad immune effector, is more likely to suppress inflammation and may be a better strategy for CV benefit.
label: none

sentence: This study underlines the need to measure and better understand HDL function.
label: none

sentence: It provides evidence for the use of anti-inflammatory treatments, particularly those modulating the TNF-α pathway, to restore the beneficial effects of HDL on the vasculature.
label: none

sentence: Our findings are of relevance to many recent clinical trials evaluating both HDL elevation and anti-inflammatory therapies with the aim of reducing CV risk.

sentence: Role of Mobile Technology to Improve Diabetes Care in Adults with Type 1 Diabetes: The Remote-T1D Study iBGStar ®  in Type 1 Diabetes Management
label: none

sentence: Introduction
label: none

sentence: The role of mobile technology in patient-reported outcomes (PRO) and glycemic control in adults with type 1 diabetes (T1D) needs further evaluation.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: The single-center, prospective, 6-month, open-label, investigator-initiated study randomized 100 subjects with T1D in a 1:1 fashion to a control group using self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) with Accu-Chek Nano® and an intervention group using SMBG with iPhone plus glucose meter (iBGStar®).
label: none

sentence: The primary endpoint was the change in PRO (hypoglycemia fear score, behavior and worry subscores).
label: none

sentence: Secondary outcomes were the improvement in glycemic variability indices and the reduction in A1c values.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: Baseline demographics and glycosylated hemoglobin (A1c) values were similar in the two groups.
label: none

sentence: There was a significant decrease in A1c value at 6 months in iBGStar® group compared to the control group (−0.16 vs. −0.51, p = 0.04).
label: none

sentence: The total insulin dose increased significantly in the iBGStar® group at 3 months but did not change at 6 months.
label: none

sentence: The hypoglycemia fear scale (PRO) improved in both groups at 6 months (−1.4 ± 10.0 vs. −3.9 ± 12.5, p = 0.32).
label: none

sentence: Conclusion
label: none

sentence: The use of iBGStar® resulted in better glycemic control and improvement in some PRO (hypoglycemia fear and behavior scores) compared to the control group at 6 months with no increased risk of hypoglycemia.
label: none

sentence: Introduction
label: none

sentence: With increasing incidence of type 1 diabetes (T1D) by 2–5% annually, 5 million people are estimated to have T1D by 2050 in the USA [1, 2].
label: none

sentence: Though intensive insulin therapy (IIT) has been shown to reduce the risk of micro- and macrovascular complications of diabetes, it is associated with a significant increase in the risk for severe hypoglycemia [3].
label: none

sentence: Even fear of hypoglycemia itself poses a significant psychological factor in patients with T1D, preventing them from achieving good glycemic control [4].
label: none

sentence: Despite increases in diabetes care, less than 20% of patients with T1D achieve good glycemic control [as defined by a glycosylated hemoglobin (A1c) of less than 7%] [5].
label: none

sentence: Self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) is a valuable tool for decision-making for both patients and clinicians.
label: none

sentence: Frequent SMBG has been shown to improve A1c and reduce hypoglycemia and hypoglycemia fear in patients with type 1 diabetes [6, 7].
label: none

sentence: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends that patients whose medication regimen includes multiple daily insulin injections or insulin pumps should test their blood glucose three times or more per day [8].
label: none

sentence: However, not all patients with diabetes test blood glucose three times or more a day [5].
label: none

sentence: Hurdles in poor adherence to SMBG include (a) inaccurate meters, (b) big and bulkier devices, (c) need to poke a finger multiple times, (d) need to carry an additional device all the time, and (e) paper log book entry [6, 7, 9, 10].
label: none

sentence: These difficulties result in poor compliance and inadequate glucose control with wide glucose excursions.
label: none

sentence: The ubiquity of smartphones and increasing availability of diabetes management mobile applications present a potential method to reduce the daily time and effort required to perform SMBG tasks and share data with a healthcare provider.
label: none

sentence: Small studies have shown improvement in glycemic control with the use of electronic log book and Internet-based glucose monitoring systems [11].
label: none

sentence: However, these studies are limited by small sample size and short duration and no reporting of hypoglycemic events [11].
label: none

sentence: Using mobile technology to facilitate the review of blood glucose data by both patients and providers could provide an opportunity to reduce glycemic variability and its associated complications [12].
label: none

sentence: The iBGStar® system is a blood glucose meter that attaches to an iPhone as a peripheral device.
label: none

sentence: Using the iBGStar® with the Diabetes Manager App, a user’s iPhone can function as a glucometer.
label: none

sentence: The Diabetes Manager App takes advantage of the existing user interface and communication capabilities of the iPhone to provide IMBG functionality on a mobile device.
label: none

sentence: This study examined the effect of iBGStar® in combination with Diabetes Manager mobile application on patient-reported outcomes (PRO) and glycemic control in adults with T1D.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: Patient Selection
label: none

sentence: This study was a single-center, prospective, randomized, open-label, and conducted at the Barbara Davis Center for Diabetes.
label: none

sentence: The protocol was approved by Colorado Multiple Institutional Review Board at the University of Colorado.
label: none

sentence: Adults (≥18 years) with T1D of more than 1-year duration and A1c below 10% were enrolled.
label: none

sentence: Pregnant women and those who intended to conceive during the study period were excluded.
label: none

sentence: Participants with T1D on systemic or inhaled steroids, history of severe hypoglycemia in the last 6 months, history of anemia or hemoglobinopathies, history of pancreatitis, history of skin disease, or allergy to adhesives and bandages precluding continuous glucose monitor (CGM) use were also excluded from the study.
label: none

sentence: Study Design, Treatment, and Follow-Up
label: none

sentence: Subjects were randomized on a 1:1 basis to either the control group or intervention group using stratified block randomization based on a screening A1c <8.5 or ≥8.5 to reduce the possibility of sampling error and ensure that randomization resulted in similar A1c results in each group.
label: none

sentence: The control group were provided with Accu-Chek Nano® meters and trained on their use at baseline and reinforced at week 1.
label: none

sentence: The iBGStar®, an iPhone 4 or 4S, and the Diabetes Manager App were provided to the intervention group.
label: none

sentence: All subjects were provided with a Dexcom SEVEN Plus® blinded CGM sensor.
label: none

sentence: The provider maintained contact with the subjects by electronic communication (email, text, or phone) every 7–14 days during the study.
label: none

sentence: Subjects in the control group were encouraged to contact their provider as needed by traditional communication (email, fax, or phone).
label: none

sentence: Those in the intervention group were invited to contact the research site if their blood glucose reading was below 60 or above 300 mg/dL using the Diabetes Manager App, which sends a notification text from the iPhone to the provider.
label: none

sentence: All diabetes treatment decisions were based on SMBG readings from either the iBGStar® or Accu-Chek Nano® glucometer, depending on group assignment.
label: none

sentence: Subjects were trained to use glucose log books and instructed to check blood glucose at least three times per day during the study.
label: none

sentence: All subjects had similar clinic and phone visits for 3 months, with a 3-month extension.
label: none

sentence: A total of eight visits were required—a screening visit, four in-clinic visits, and three phone calls.
label: none

sentence: A Dexcom SEVEN Plus® blinded CGM sensor was inserted each clinic visit starting from visit 2 for a total of four visits (for four separate 7-day periods of blinded CGM at visits 2, 4, 6, and 8).
label: none

sentence: During the week of blinded CGM use, subjects were not allowed to use their own real-time CGMs.
label: none

sentence: Subjects were instructed not to take acetaminophen during blinded CGM period as per the label.
label: none

sentence: Outcome Measurements
label: none

sentence: A1C, complete metabolic panel, and complete cell counts were measured at baseline, 1, 3, and 6 months.
label: none

sentence: A1c was measured by DCA 2000.
label: none

sentence: Data on insulin dose was collected from participants by self-report based on logbook entries.
label: none

sentence: The PRO directly describes the patient’s perception of a disease and its treatment without the interpretation of responses by a physician.
label: none

sentence: Hypoglycemia perspective questionnaire and hypoglycemia fear score are the most common tools used for hypoglycemia assessment.
label: none

sentence: Hypoglycemia fear was measured using a 27-question instrument (score range 27–135) with subscales for behavior (10 questions) and worry (17 questions) at the screening and 3- and 6-month visits [13] (Supplement 1).
label: none

sentence: Measurements of average blood glucose and glucose variability were carried out from blinded CGM tracings.
label: none

sentence: Statistical Analysis
label: none

sentence: The analysis was conducted with the intent-to-treat concept.
label: none

sentence: The primary efficacy endpoint was patient-reported outcomes, including the change in the hypoglycemia fear questionnaire score from baseline to 3 and 6 months.
label: none

sentence: Secondary outcomes were the improvement in glycemic variability indices and the reduction in A1c values.
label: none

sentence: Improvement in glycemic control was measured as the difference in the change in A1c laboratory values of the two arms of the study between baseline and 3 and 6 months.
label: none

sentence: Changes in the primary and secondary efficacy endpoints were assessed using paired t tests examining changes from baseline to 3 months and baseline to 6 months.
label: none

sentence: Linear regression mixed models were used to assess changes in the primary and secondary endpoints over time, using repeated measures analyses.
label: none

sentence: As this was a pilot study, formal power calculations were not performed for the primary or secondary endpoints.
label: none

sentence: Statistical significance was defined as p < 0.05.
label: none

sentence: All analyses were performed using SAS, version 9.4 (SAS Institute, Cary, NC, USA).
label: none

sentence: In a post-study survey, 88% of the subjects who used iBGStar® were satisfied with the system.
label: none

sentence: Seventy-five percent of the subjects found the iBGStar® system with the Diabetes Manager App on the iPhone easier than their conventional glucometer for managing their diabetes.
label: none

sentence: Diabetes Manager App was found to be very user-friendly by about 90% of the subjects.
label: none

sentence: Discussion
label: none

sentence: Blood glucose monitoring is an important part of diabetes management, especially in patients on insulin.
label: none

sentence: The Diabetes Control and Complications Trial showed that frequent blood glucose monitoring along with intensive therapy is required to maintain tight glycemic control [14].
label: none

sentence: Communication errors between the patients and the providers, absence of documentation of blood glucose results, and failure of downloading glucometers in care centers are common difficulties in diabetes care.
label: none

sentence: New technologies require a better understanding by both patients and healthcare workers [15].
label: none

sentence: An accurate and convenient way for routine blood glucose monitoring and reporting is essential for following the treatment and making necessary therapeutic changes.
label: none

sentence: Integration of smartphones into our life brought new opportunities in healthcare.
label: none

sentence: The use of the Diabetes Manager App with the iBGStar® facilitated electronic communication between participants and providers.
label: none

sentence: The precision of iBGStar® was shown previously in an in vitro diagnostic device study [16].
label: none

sentence: Diabetes Manager App allowed participants to upload and review SMBG data on an iPhone.
label: none

sentence: Even though there was no significant difference between hypoglycemia fear or behavior scales, the subjects indicated that they felt more comfortable using the iBGStar® system.
label: none

sentence: Ease of use and convenience probably resulted in greater patient satisfaction at the post-study survey.
label: none

sentence: The app allowed the patient to filter and dynamically interact with log book data, graph trends, and view statistics.
label: none

sentence: Rather than searching through a report, the user can take advantage of features in the app to produce specific queries related to their needs.
label: none

sentence: In our study, using the iBGStar® system improved A1c at 3 months which was maintained at 6 months when compared to the control group.
label: none

sentence: Increased insulin requirements may partially explain the decrease of A1C in the iBGStar® group.
label: none

sentence: This was a pilot study.
label: none

sentence: One of the strengths of this study was that no one had previously evaluated the role of mobile technology in diabetes care.
label: none

sentence: Our goal was to learn from this study and plan for a much larger study using social media in the future after implementing changes that would be learned from this pilot study.
label: none

sentence: We had objective measures of patient-reported outcomes and treatment satisfaction using validated tools.
label: none

sentence: Limitations of this study were that this was a short-term (6 months) study in a single center and we only focused on hypoglycemia risk at CGM and we did not analyze the other blood glucose variabilities.
label: limitation

sentence: Therefore, the results may not be generalized.
label: limitation

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: The use of iBGStar® in combination with Diabetes Manager mobile application improved some PRO (hypoglycemia fear and behavior score) and glycemic control at 6 months without an increased risk of hypoglycemia.
label: none

sentence: Further studies would be required to determine the effects of iBGStar® system and Diabetes Manager App in the long term.

sentence: Male non-insulin users with type 2 diabetes mellitus are predisposed to gastric corpus-predominant inflammation after  H. pylori  infection
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: Both H. pylori infection and diabetes increase the risk of gastric cancer.
label: none

sentence: This study investigated whether patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and H. pylori infection had more severe corpus gastric inflammation and higher prevalence of precancerous lesions than non-diabetic controls.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: A total of 797 patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus were screened for H. pylori, of whom 264 had H. pylori infection.
label: none

sentence: Of these patients, 129 received esophagogastroduodenoscopy to obtain topographic gastric specimens for gastric histology according to the modified Updated Sydney System, corpus-predominant gastritis index (CGI), Operative Link on Gastritis Assessment, and Operative Link on Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia Assessment.
label: none

sentence: Non-diabetic dyspeptic patients who had H. pylori infection confirmed by esophagogastroduodenoscopy were enrolled as controls.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: The male as well as total T2DM patients had higher acute/chronic inflammatory and lymphoid follicle scores in the corpus than non-diabetic controls (p < 0.05).
label: none

sentence: In contrast, the female T2DM patients had higher chronic inflammatory scores in the antrum than the controls (p < 0.05).
label: none

sentence: In T2DM patients, the males had significantly higher rates of CGI than the females (p < 0.05).
label: none

sentence: Multivariate logistic regression analysis showed that male patients (odds ratio: 2.28, 95% confidence interval: 1.11–4.69, p = 0.025) and non-insulin users (odds ratio: 0.33, 95% confidence interval: 0.15–0.74, p = 0.007) were independent factors for the presence of CGI in the H. pylori-infected patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: Patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and H. pylori infection had more severe corpus gastric inflammation than non-diabetic controls.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, male gender and non-insulin users of T2DM patients were predisposed to have corpus-predominant gastritis after H. pylori infection.
label: none

sentence: Trial registration
label: none

sentence: ClinicalTrial: NCT02466919, retrospectively registered may 17, 2015.
label: none

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: H. pylori infection is known to increase the risk of gastric cancers [1, 2], and both chronic atrophic gastritis and intestinal metaplasia have been reported to be precancerous lesions that can potentially develop into gastric adenocarcinoma [3, 4].
label: none

sentence: The Operative Link on Gastritis Assessment (OLGA) and Operative Link on Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia Assessment (OLGIM) gastritis staging systems are based on the histology of both antrum and corpus tissues and can be applied to assess the risk of gastric cancer in patients with premalignant lesions [5, 6].
label: none

sentence: A more advanced OLGA and OLGIM stage indicates corpus predominance and higher risk of gastric cancer.
label: none

sentence: Our recent previous study further disclosed that the corpus-predominant gastritis index (CGI) can be used to identify H. pylori-infected patients currently without intestinal metaplasia who are at an increased risk of gastric cancer earlier than the OLGA and OLGIM staging systems [7].
label: none

sentence: Accordingly, if the high-risk group can be identified earlier by gastric histology, H. pylori eradication can be performed to control the risk of gastric cancer [8].
label: none

sentence: Patients with diabetes mellitus (DM) and poor glycemic control are associated with a higher prevalence of gastrointestinal symptoms [9].
label: none

sentence: H. pylori infection has also been associated with insulin resistance and the development of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) [10–12].
label: none

sentence: Nevertheless, it remains controversial whether patients with diabetes are predisposed to H. pylori infection [13–16].
label: none

sentence: Several recent studies have shown that patients with DM who live in areas with a higher prevalence of H. pylori and gastric cancer and those with a longer duration of diabetes and poor glycemic control are predisposed to an increased risk of gastric cancer [17–19].
label: none

sentence: These observations suggest that even though the association between T2DM and a higher rate of H. pylori infection is controversial, the risk of gastric cancer is higher in patients with T2DM once infected with H. pylori.
label: none

sentence: Therefore, the early detection and prompt treatment of H. pylori infection should be a priority to reduce the risk of gastric cancer in patients with T2DM.
label: none

sentence: Quatrinie et al.
label: none

sentence: reported 23 diabetic patients with active gastritis, 25% of whom had intestinal metaplasia [14].
label: none

sentence: In contrast, Małlecki et al.
label: none

sentence: reported a lower prevalence (41% vs. 71%) of chronic active gastritis in 39 patients with DM than in non-diabetic controls [20].
label: none

sentence: Therefore, we conducted this large-scale comparison between patients with T2DM and non-diabetic dyspeptic controls to investigate whether T2DM predisposes patients to a higher rate of precancerous lesions, more advanced OLGA or OLGIM stage, or a higher rate of CGI to predict the risk of gastric cancer after H. pylori infection.
label: none

sentence: Our results disclosed that male patients and non-insulin users with T2DM were predisposed to have CGI.
label: none

sentence: These findings may offer a promising risk factor stratification tool to identify the high-risk group of patients with T2DM who would benefit from earlier H. pylori eradication to control gastric cancer.
label: none

sentence: Discussions
label: none

sentence: The results of this large-scale, case-control study are highly original to illustrate that male patients with T2DM had higher chronic and acute inflammatory scores in the corpus than non-diabetic dyspeptic controls.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, H. pylori-infected diabetic patients who were male and non-insulin users had a higher risk of CGI.
label: none

sentence: This suggests that this high-risk group should receive earlier anti-H. pylori therapy to reduce the risk of gastric cancer.
label: none

sentence: H. pylori infection is defined as a type I World Health Organization carcinogen for gastric adenocarcinoma [25].
label: none

sentence: A large-scale meta-analysis showed that patients with diabetes had an increased risk of gastric cancer unrelated to their geographical region of residence.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, after adjusting for the prevalence of H. pylori infection, the risk was two-fold higher [26].
label: none

sentence: These results suggest that diabetic patients with H. pylori infection are at a higher risk of gastric cancer, although the underlying mechanism remains unclear.
label: none

sentence: Chronic gastric inflammation has been reported to play a major role in gastric carcinogenesis [27, 28].
label: none

sentence: In addition, more severe chronic gastric inflammation in the corpus has been reported to result in an increased risk of gastric cancer [28].
label: none

sentence: We found that the patients with T2DM and H. pylori infection had more severe inflammation in the corpus than those without diabetes.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, the aggregation of lymphoid hyperplasia, which indicates the severity and activity of mucosal inflammation [29], was also severe in both the antrum and corpus of the patients with T2DM.
label: none

sentence: A greater severity of chronic gastric inflammation in the corpus in patients with T2DM may therefore lead to an increased risk of gastric cancer.
label: none

sentence: Males are known to have a higher risk of gastric cancer, and is similar in populations with high and low incidence of gastric cancer [30].
label: none

sentence: 17β-estradiol (E2) has been shown to reduce female gastric neutrophil infiltration and prevent H. pylori-induced gastric cancer in mice [31].
label: none

sentence: Other reproductive factors such as years of fertility and parity are associated to gastric cancer development [32, 33], however, the results are not consistent [34].
label: none

sentence: However, the accurately biological mechanism of gender difference in gastric cancer risk needs more detail study.
label: none

sentence: In the current study, we found that H. pylori-infected male patients with T2DM but not female patients had higher levels of neutrophils and lymphocytes over the corpus (Table 1) compared to the controls.
label: none

sentence: Moreover, the male patients with T2DM had a significantly higher rate of CGI than the female patients with T2DM (Table 2).
label: none

sentence: These findings are consistent with the general concept that males are at a higher risk of gastric cancer, and also that male patients with T2DM are at a higher risk of gastric precancerous lesions than females.
label: none

sentence: Insulin is the principle therapy for both patients with type 1 DM and also for those with T2DM with a poor response to oral hypoglycemic agents.
label: none

sentence: We found that not using insulin was a significant factor for the development of CGI.
label: none

sentence: Kim et al.
label: none

sentence: reported that a lower fasting glucose level (<86 mg/dL) was significantly associated with an increased risk of distal gastric cancer compared to a normal level [35].
label: none

sentence: However, there were no significant differences in fasting sugar or HbA1c levels between the patients with and without CGI in this study.
label: none

sentence: Furthermore, the insulin-like growth factor pathway has been reported to play a key role in the malignant progression of esophageal cancer in in vitro and in vivo studies [36].
label: none

sentence: In addition, a large follow-up cohort study showed that the use of insulin and glinides was associated with a higher risk of stomach cancer [37].
label: none

sentence: In contrast to our findings, a large population-based study reported that the use of insulin was not associated with the risk of gastric cancer [38].
label: none

sentence: Therefore, further large-scale longitudinal observational studies are needed to elucidate the association between the use of insulin in patients with diabetes and gastric malignancy.
label: none

sentence: Atrophic gastritis and intestinal metaplasia are known to be precancerous lesions predisposing to gastric carcinogenesis [3, 7].
label: none

sentence: Our previous study showed that patients with gastric cancer had a higher prevalence of CGI and OLGIM stage II-IV.
label: none

sentence: In addition, CGI has been reported to be highly correlated to the presence of spasmolytic polypeptide-expressing metaplasia [7].
label: none

sentence: Although we did not find a higher grade of OLGA or OLGIM in the patients with T2DM compared to the controls, the male patients with T2DM had a higher rate of CGI than the female patients with T2DM (Table 3).
label: none

sentence: This suggests that the higher prevalence of gastric cancer in H. pylori-infected male patients with T2DM may be caused by chronic corpus inflammation and CGI rather than intestinal metaplasia.
label: none

sentence: There are some limitations to this study.
label: none

sentence: First, all of the non-diabetic control patients were dyspeptic, so that we could not investigate the role of dyspeptic symptoms in the development of gastric precancerous lesions.
label: limitation

sentence: Furthermore, the other risk factors related to gastric cancer such as cigarette smoking, dietary habits, and body mass index were not available in controls.
label: limitation

sentence: Second, the analysis of hypoglycemic drugs for precancerous lesions was limited to insulin.
label: limitation

sentence: Third, the exact mechanism by which chronic inflammation rather than chronic atrophic gastritis-intestinal metaplasia induces gastric carcinogenesis in patients with T2DM remains unclear.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: In conclusion, the patients with T2DM had more severe corpus gastric inflammation than the non-diabetic controls after H. pylori infection.
label: none

sentence: Male sex and not using insulin were independent risk factors for CGI after H. pylori infection in the patients with T2DM.
label: none

sentence: Treating male patients with T2DM who do not use insulin for H. pylori treatment may be promising in reducing the risk of gastric cancer.

sentence: Informed, advance refusals of treatment by people with severe mental illness in a randomised controlled trial of joint crisis plans: demand, content and correlates

sentence: Background
label: none

sentence: In the UK, crisis planning for mental health care should acknowledge the right to make an informed advance treatment refusal under the Mental Capacity Act 2005.
label: none

sentence: Our aims were to estimate the demand for such treatment refusals within a sample of service users who had had a recent hospital admission for psychosis or bipolar disorder, and to examine the relationship between refusals, and service user characteristics.
label: none

sentence: Methods
label: none

sentence: To identify refusals we conducted content analysis of Joint Crisis Plans, which are plans formulated by service users and their clinical team with involvement from an external facilitator, and routine care plans in sub-samples from a multi-centre randomised controlled trial of Joint Crisis Plans (plus routine mental health care) versus routine care alone (CRIMSON) in England.
label: none

sentence: Factors hypothesised to be associated with refusals were identified using the trial data collected through baseline interviews of service users and clinicians and collection of routine clinical data.
label: none

sentence: Results
label: none

sentence: Ninety-nine of 221 (45%) of the Joint Crisis Plans contained a treatment refusal compared to 10 of 424 (2.4%) baseline routine care plans.
label: none

sentence: No Joint Crisis Plans recorded disagreement with refusals on the part of clinicians.
label: none

sentence: Among those with completed Joint Crisis Plans, adjusted analyses indicated a significant association between treatment refusals and perceived coercion at baseline (odds ratio = 1.21, 95% CI 1.02–1.43), but not with baseline working alliance or a past history of involuntary admission.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions
label: none

sentence: We demonstrated significant demand for written treatment refusals in line with the Mental Capacity Act 2005, which had not previously been elicited by the process of treatment planning.
label: none

sentence: Future treatment/crisis plans should incorporate the opportunity for service users to record a treatment refusal during the drafting of such plans.
label: none
